verses.1:1: A vision that Isaiah son of Amoz saw, which he saw against Judea and against Jerusalem, in the reign of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, who reigned over Judea.
verses.1:2: Hear, heaven, and listen closely, earth, for the Lord has spoken: "I fathered sons and exalted them, but they rejected Me.
verses.1:3: An ox knows its owner, and a donkey its master's feeding trough; but Israel does not know Me, and the people do not understand Me."
verses.1:4: Woe, sinful nation, people full of sins, evil seed, lawless sons! You have abandoned the Lord and provoked the Holy One of Israel to anger.
verses.1:5: Why should you still be struck while adding lawlessness? Every head is in pain, and every heart is in grief.
verses.1:6: From feet to head there is neither wound nor bruise nor festering blow; there is no salve to apply, nor oil, nor bandages.
verses.1:7: Your land is desolate, your cities are burned with fire; your country—aliens are devouring it before you, and it has been made desolate, overthrown by alien peoples.
verses.1:8: The daughter of Zion will be abandoned like a tent in a vineyard, and like a watchman's hut in a cucumber field, like a besieged city.
verses.1:9: And if the Lord Sabaoth had not left us seed, we would have become like Sodom, and we would have been made like Gomorrah.
verses.1:10: Hear the word of the Lord, rulers of Sodom; pay attention to the law of God, people of Gomorrah.
verses.1:11: "What to Me is the multitude of your sacrifices?" says the Lord. "I am full of whole burnt offerings of rams, and I do not want the fat of lambs and the blood of bulls and goats,
verses.1:12: not even if you come to appear before Me. For who required these things from your hands? To trample My court
verses.1:13: you will not continue; if you bring fine flour, it is worthless; incense—it is an abomination to Me; your new moons and the Sabbaths and a great day I do not endure; fasting and idleness
verses.1:14: and your new moons and your festivals My soul hates; you have become a surfeit to Me; I will no longer forgive your sins.
verses.1:15: When you stretch out your hands, I will turn My eyes away from you; and if you multiply prayer, I will not listen to you, for your hands are full of blood.
verses.1:16: Wash yourselves, become clean, remove the evil deeds from your souls before My eyes; cease from your evil deeds,
verses.1:17: learn to do good, seek justice, rescue the one being wronged, render justice for the orphan, and vindicate the widow."
verses.1:18: "And come, let us settle our case," says the Lord. "Even if your sins are like crimson, I will make them white like snow; and if they are like scarlet, I will make them white like wool.
verses.1:19: And if you are willing and listen to Me, you will eat the good things of the land;
verses.1:20: but if you are not willing and do not listen to Me, a sword will devour you," for the mouth of the Lord has spoken these things.
verses.1:21: How has the faithful city Zion, full of justice, become a prostitute? In it righteousness lodged, but now murderers!
verses.1:22: Your silver is debased; your tavern-keepers mix the wine with water.
verses.1:23: Your rulers are disobedient, companions of thieves, loving gifts, pursuing repayment, not rendering justice for orphans, and not paying attention to the case of widows.
verses.1:24: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Master Sabaoth: "Woe to the mighty ones of Israel! For My wrath will not cease against the adversaries, and I will execute judgment on My enemies.
verses.1:25: And I will bring My hand upon you and refine you to purity; the disobedient I will destroy, and I will remove all lawless ones from you;
verses.1:26: and I will establish your judges as before, and your counselors as from the beginning; and after these things you will be called, 'City of Righteousness, Faithful Metropolis Zion.'"
verses.1:27: For with judgment her captivity will be saved, and with mercy;
verses.1:28: and the lawless and the sinners will be crushed together, and those who abandon the Lord will be consumed;
verses.1:29: for they will be put to shame because of their idols, which they themselves wanted, and they were put to shame over the gardens that they desired.
verses.1:30: For they will be like a terebinth that has shed its leaves, and like a garden having no water;
verses.1:31: and their strength will be like a stalk of tow, and their works like sparks, and the lawless and the sinners will be burned up together, and there will be no one to quench them.
verses.2:1: The word that came to Isaiah son of Amoz concerning Judea and concerning Jerusalem.
verses.2:2: For in the last days the mountain of the Lord will be clearly visible, and the house of God on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills, and all the nations will come to it.
verses.2:3: And many nations will go and say, "Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord and to the house of the God of Jacob, and He will declare to us His way, and we will walk in it." For from Zion law will go forth, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem;
verses.2:4: and He will judge between the nations, and will reprove a numerous people; and they will beat their swords into plows and their spears into sickles, and nation will not take a sword against nation, and they will never again learn to wage war.
verses.2:5: And now, house of Jacob, come, let us walk in the light of the Lord.
verses.2:6: For He has forsaken His people, the house of Israel, because their country was filled, as from the beginning, with divinations, like that of the foreigners, and many foreign children became theirs.
verses.2:7: For their country was filled with silver and gold, and there was no number to their treasures; and the land was filled with horses, and there was no number to their chariots;
verses.2:8: and the land was filled with abominations, the works of their hands, and they worshiped what their fingers made;
verses.2:9: and a human being bowed down, and a man was brought low, and I will certainly not forgive them.
verses.2:10: And now, enter into the rocks and hide yourselves in the earth from before the terror of the Lord and from the glory of His strength, when He rises to shatter the earth.
verses.2:11: For the eyes of the Lord are high, while humanity is low; and the loftiness of human beings will be brought low, and the Lord alone will be exalted in that day.
verses.2:12: For the day of the Lord Sabaoth is against everyone who is arrogant and proud, and against everyone who is high and lofty, and they will be brought low,
verses.2:13: and against every cedar of Lebanon, of the high and lofty ones, and against every oak tree of Bashan,
verses.2:14: and against every mountain, and against every high hill,
verses.2:15: and against every high tower, and against every high wall,
verses.2:16: and against every ship of the sea, and against every sight of ships of beauty;
verses.2:17: and every human being will be brought low, and the arrogance of human beings will fall, and the Lord alone will be exalted in that day.
verses.2:18: And they will hide away all the handmade things,
verses.2:19: carrying them into the caves, and into the clefts of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of the Lord and from the glory of His strength, when He rises to shatter the earth.
verses.2:20: For on that day a human being will throw out his silver and gold abominations, which they made to worship, to the worthless things and to the bats,
verses.2:21: in order to enter into the holes of the solid rock and into the clefts of the rocks, from before the terror of the Lord and from the glory of His strength, when He rises to shatter the earth.
verses.3:1: Look now, the Master, the Lord Sabaoth will take away from Jerusalem and from Judea a strong man and a strong woman, strength of bread and strength of water,
verses.3:2: a giant and a strong man and a fighting man and a judge and a prophet and a diviner and an elder,
verses.3:3: and a captain of fifty and a marvelous counselor and a wise master builder and an intelligent listener.
verses.3:4: And I will appoint youths as their rulers, and mockers will rule over them.
verses.3:5: And the people will clash, person against person, and a person against his neighbor; the child will strike against the old man, the dishonored against the honored.
verses.3:6: For a man will take hold of his brother or of a relative of his father, saying, "You have a cloak; become our leader, and let my food be under you."
verses.3:7: And answering, he will say in that day, "I will not be your leader, for there is neither bread nor cloak in my house; I will not be a leader of this people."
verses.3:8: For Jerusalem has been abandoned and Judea has collapsed, and their tongues are with lawlessness, disobeying what concerns the Lord; because now their glory has been humbled,
verses.3:9: and the shame of their face stood against them; and they declared and displayed their sin like that of Sodom. Woe to their soul, because they have counseled an evil counsel against themselves,
verses.3:10: saying, "Let us bind the righteous one, because he is troublesome to us." Therefore they will eat the produce of their works.
verses.3:11: Woe to the lawless one! Evil things according to the works of his hands will happen to him.
verses.3:12: My people, your exactors glean you, and those who make demands rule over you. My people, those who call you blessed lead you astray and disturb the path of your feet.
verses.3:13: But now the Lord will take His stand for judgment, and will bring His people to judgment;
verses.3:14: the Lord Himself will come to judgment with the elders of the people and with its rulers. But you, why have you burned My vineyard, and the plunder of the poor is in your houses?
verses.3:15: Why do you wrong My people, and put the face of the poor to shame?
verses.3:16: Thus says the Lord, "Because the daughters of Zion have been exalted, and have walked with a high neck and with winks of the eyes, and in the gait of their feet trailing their tunics at the same time, and dancing with their feet at the same time,
verses.3:17: God will humble the ruling daughters of Zion. And the Lord will uncover their form
verses.3:18: in that day; and the Lord will take away the glory of their clothing, the hair braids and the hairnets and the crescents,
verses.3:19: and the pendant and the adornment of their face,
verses.3:20: and the array of the adornment of glory, and the armlets and the bracelets and the hair braid and the finger rings and the wristbands and the earrings,
verses.3:21: and the purple-bordered garments and the purple-striped garments,
verses.3:22: and the wraps for the house and the transparent Laconian garments,
verses.3:23: and the fine linen garments and the hyacinth-blue and scarlet ones, and the fine linen, interwoven with gold and hyacinth-blue, and flowing summer veils.
verses.3:24: And instead of sweet fragrance there will be dust, and instead of a belt you will gird yourself with a rope, and instead of the golden adornment of the head you will have baldness because of your works; and instead of the purple-striped tunic you will wrap yourself with sackcloth.
verses.3:25: And your most handsome son whom you love will fall by the sword, and your strong men will fall by the sword and be humbled;
verses.3:26: and the cases of your adornment will mourn, and you will be left alone and dashed to the ground."
verses.4:1: And seven women will take hold of one man, saying, "We will eat our own bread and put on our own garments; only let your name be called upon us; take away our reproach."
verses.4:2: But in that day God will shine forth in counsel with glory upon the earth, to exalt and glorify what is left of Israel;
verses.4:3: and it will be that what remains in Zion and what is left in Jerusalem—all who have been written for life in Jerusalem will be called holy.
verses.4:4: For the Lord will wash away the filth of the sons and of the daughters of Zion, and will cleanse the blood from their midst by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of burning.
verses.4:5: And He will come, and it will be that a cloud will overshadow every place of Mount Zion and all things around it by day, and as of smoke and of light of a fire burning by night, and with all the glory it will be sheltered;
verses.4:6: and it will be for a shade from heat, and in shelter and in a hiding place from severity and rain.
verses.5:1: I will sing now to the beloved a song of my beloved for my vineyard. A vineyard belonged to the beloved on a horn in a fertile place.
verses.5:2: And I put a fence around it and enclosed it with stakes, and I planted a Sorek vine, and I built a tower in the middle of it, and I dug a wine-vat in it; and I waited for it to produce grapes, and it produced thorns.
verses.5:3: And now, you who dwell in Jerusalem and man of Judah, judge between Me and My vineyard.
verses.5:4: What more shall I do for My vineyard that I have not done for it? Because I waited for it to produce grapes, yet it produced thorns.
verses.5:5: Now then I will declare to you what I will do to My vineyard: I will take away its fence and it will be for plunder, and I will tear down its wall and it will be for trampling.
verses.5:6: And I will abandon My vineyard, and it will by no means be pruned nor dug, and thorns will come up upon it as upon barren ground; and I will command the clouds not to rain down rain upon it.
verses.5:7: For the vineyard of the Lord Sabaoth is the house of Israel, and the man of Judah is a beloved new planting; I waited for it to produce justice, yet it produced lawlessness, and not righteousness, but an outcry.
verses.5:8: Woe to those who join house to house and bring field near to field, so that they may take away something from their neighbor! Surely you will not dwell alone upon the land?
verses.5:9: For these things were heard in the ears of the Lord Sabaoth: for if houses become many, they will become a desolation; great and fine, yet there will be no one dwelling in them.
verses.5:10: For where ten pairs of oxen work, it will produce one jar, and he who sows six artabas will produce three measures.
verses.5:11: Woe to those who rise in the morning and pursue strong drink, who stay into the evening; for wine will burn them up.
verses.5:12: For with lyre and harp and tambourines and flutes they drink the wine, yet they do not look at the works of the Lord, and they do not consider the works of His hands.
verses.5:13: Therefore My people became captive because they did not know the Lord, and a multitude of the dead came to be because of famine and thirst for water.
verses.5:14: And Hades enlarged its soul and opened wide its mouth without ceasing, and down will go the glorious ones and the great ones and the rich ones and her pestilent ones.
verses.5:15: And a person will be humbled, and a man will be dishonored, and the lofty eyes will be humbled;
verses.5:16: and the Lord Sabaoth will be exalted in judgment, and the holy God will be glorified in righteousness;
verses.5:17: and those who were plundered will graze like bulls, and lambs will eat the desolate places of those who have been taken away.
verses.5:18: Woe to those who drag sins along as with a long rope, and lawless deeds as with the yoke strap of a heifer,
verses.5:19: who say, "Quickly let what He will do draw near, so that we may see, and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel come, so that we may know."
verses.5:20: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who make darkness light and light darkness, who make bitter sweet and sweet bitter.
verses.5:21: Woe to those who are intelligent in themselves and knowledgeable in their own sight.
verses.5:22: Woe to your strong men who drink wine, and the mighty men who mix strong drink,
verses.5:23: who justify the ungodly for the sake of bribes, and take away the right of the righteous one.
verses.5:24: Therefore just as stubble will be burned by a coal of fire, and will be burned up by an unleashed flame, their root will be like chaff, and their blossom will go up like dust; for they did not desire the law of the Lord Sabaoth, but provoked the oracle of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.5:25: And the Lord Sabaoth became furious with anger against His people, and He laid His hand upon them and struck them; and the mountains were provoked, and their corpses became like dung in the middle of a road. And in all these things His fury has not turned away, but His hand is still uplifted.
verses.5:26: Therefore He will lift up a signal among the nations far away and will whistle to them from the end of the earth, and look, swiftly, lightly they come.
verses.5:27: They will not hunger nor grow weary, nor slumber nor sleep, nor untie their belts from their waist, nor will the straps of their sandals be broken;
verses.5:28: whose arrows are sharp and their bows are strung. The feet of their horses are like solid rock; the wheels of their chariots have been reckoned like a whirlwind.
verses.5:29: They rage like lions, they have taken their stand like a lion's cubs; and he will seize, and roar like a wild beast, and cast out, and there will be no one to rescue them;
verses.5:30: and he will roar because of them in that day like the sound of a surging sea; and they will look to the land, and look, harsh darkness in their distress.
verses.6:1: And it came about in the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a high and exalted throne, and the house was full of His glory.
verses.6:2: And seraphim were standing around Him; one had six wings, and another had six wings: with two they were covering their faces, with two they were covering their feet, and with two they were flying.
verses.6:3: And one cried out to another, and they were saying, "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord Sabaoth; all the earth is full of His glory."
verses.6:4: And the lintel was lifted up at the voice with which they cried out, and the house was filled with smoke.
verses.6:5: And I said, "Oh, wretched am I, for I am cut to the heart! Because being a man and having unclean lips, I live in the midst of a people having unclean lips, and I have seen the King, the Lord Sabaoth, with my eyes."
verses.6:6: And one of the seraphim was sent to me, and in its hand it had a live coal that it had taken with the tongs from the altar,
verses.6:7: and it touched my mouth and said, "Look, this has touched your lips, and will take away your iniquities and completely cleanse your sins."
verses.6:8: And I heard the voice of the Lord saying, "Whom shall I send, and who will go to this people?" And I said, "Here I am; send me."
verses.6:9: And He said, "Go and say to this people, 'Hearing you will hear, and you will by no means understand; and looking you will look, and you will by no means see.'
verses.6:10: For the heart of this people has grown calloused, and with their ears they heard heavily, and they closed their eyes, so that they might never see with their eyes and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart and turn back, and I will heal them."
verses.6:11: And I said, "How long, Lord?" And He said, "Until cities are laid waste because they are not inhabited, and houses because there are no people, and the land will be left desolate.
verses.6:12: And after these things God will remove the people far away, and those who are left will be multiplied on the land,
verses.6:13: and still on it is the tenth part, and again it will be for plunder, like a terebinth and like an acorn when it falls out of its husk."
verses.7:1: And it came about in the days of Ahaz, son of Jotham, son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up against Jerusalem to make war on it, and they were not able to besiege it.
verses.7:2: And it was reported to the house of David, saying, "Aram has made an agreement with Ephraim." And his soul and the soul of his people were dismayed, just as a tree in a forest is shaken by the wind.
verses.7:3: And the Lord said to Isaiah, "Go out to meet Ahaz, you and Jashub who is left, your son, to the pool of the upper road of the fuller's field,
verses.7:4: and say to him, 'Take care to remain calm and do not be afraid, and do not let your soul grow weak because of these two pieces of wood, these smoking firebrands; for when the anger of My wrath comes, I will heal again.
verses.7:5: And the son of Aram and the son of Remaliah, because they have planned an evil plan:
verses.7:6: "We will go up into Judea, and having spoken with them, we will turn them to ourselves, and we will make the son of Tabeel king over it,"
verses.7:7: thus says the Lord Sabaoth, "This plan will by no means endure, nor will it come about.
verses.7:8: Rather, the head of Aram is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; yet within sixty-five years more, the kingdom of Ephraim will cease from being a people.
verses.7:9: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is the son of Remaliah; and if you do not believe, neither will you by any means understand."'"
verses.7:10: And the Lord spoke again to Ahaz, saying,
verses.7:11: "Ask for yourself a sign from the Lord your God, in depth or in height."
verses.7:12: And Ahaz said, "I will by no means ask, nor will I test the Lord."
verses.7:13: And he said, "Listen now, house of David: Is it a small thing for you to cause trouble for people, and how is it that you cause trouble for the Lord?
verses.7:14: Therefore the Lord Himself will give you a sign: Look, the virgin will conceive in the womb and give birth to a son, and you will call His name Immanuel.
verses.7:15: He will eat butter and honey before He knows or prefers evil things, to choose the good;
verses.7:16: for before the child knows good or evil, He refuses wickedness to choose the good, and the land that you fear because of the presence of the two kings will be forsaken.
verses.7:17: But God will bring upon you and upon your people and upon your father's house days that have not yet come since the day He took away Ephraim from Judah—the king of the Assyrians."
verses.7:18: And it will happen in that day that the Lord will whistle to flies, which will rule over part of the river of Egypt, and to the bee that is in the country of the Assyrians;
verses.7:19: and they will all come in the ravines of the country and in the crevices of the rocks, and into the caves and into every fissure.
verses.7:20: In that day the Lord will shave the head with the razor hired beyond the river of the king of the Assyrians, and He will take away the hair of the feet and the beard.
verses.7:21: And it will happen in that day, a man will raise a heifer of cattle and two sheep;
verses.7:22: and it will happen, from the producing of abundant milk, that everyone who is left on the land will eat butter and honey.
verses.7:23: And it will happen in that day, every place where there are a thousand vines worth a thousand shekels will become barren ground and thorns;
verses.7:24: with arrow and bow they will enter there, because all the land will be barren ground and thorns.
verses.7:25: And every mountain that is plowed will be plowed; fear will by no means come there, for from the barren ground and thorns it will become pasture for sheep and trampling for cattle.
verses.8:1: And the Lord said to me, "Take for yourself a new, large scroll, and write on it with a man's stylus, 'To swiftly make plunder of spoils'—for it is at hand—
verses.8:2: and make faithful men witnesses for Me, Uriah and Zechariah son of Berechiah."
verses.8:3: And I approached the prophetess, and she conceived in the womb and gave birth to a son. And the Lord said to me, "Call his name 'Quickly Spoil, Swiftly Plunder';
verses.8:4: for before the child knows how to call out father or mother, one will take the wealth of Damascus and the spoils of Samaria before the king of the Assyrians."
verses.8:5: And the Lord spoke to me yet again:
verses.8:6: "Because this people does not want the water of Siloam that flows quietly, but wants to have Rezin and the son of Remaliah as king over you,
verses.8:7: therefore look, the Lord is bringing up upon you the strong and abundant water of the river, the king of the Assyrians and his glory; and he will go up over every ravine of yours, and he will walk over every wall of yours,
verses.8:8: and he will take away from Judea any man who will be able to lift a head or is able to accomplish anything; and his camp will be such as to fill the breadth of your country. God is with us."
verses.8:9: Know, nations, and be defeated; give ear as far as the end of the earth; having grown strong, be defeated; for if you grow strong again, again you will be defeated.
verses.8:10: And whatever plan you plan, the Lord will scatter, and whatever word you speak will by no means remain with you, because God is with us.
verses.8:11: Thus says the Lord: "With the strong hand they refuse the course of the way of this people, saying,
verses.8:12: 'May they never say anything hard, for everything that this people says is hard; yet by no means fear their fear, nor be troubled.
verses.8:13: Sanctify the Lord Himself, and He Himself will be your fear.
verses.8:14: And if you are trusting in Him, He will be a sanctuary to you, and you will not encounter Him as a stumbling of a stone, nor as a falling of a rock. But the houses of Jacob are in a snare, and sitting in a hollow in Jerusalem;
verses.8:15: therefore many among them will be powerless, and they will fall and be shattered, and people in security will draw near and be captured.'"
verses.8:16: Then those who seal up the law so as not to learn will be revealed.
verses.8:17: And he will say, "I will wait for God, who has turned His face away from the house of Jacob, and I will trust in Him.
verses.8:18: Here I am, and the children whom God has given me. And there will be signs and wonders in the house of Israel from the Lord Sabaoth, who dwells on Mount Zion."
verses.8:19: And if they say to you, "Seek the mediums and those who speak from the ground, the empty talkers who speak out of the belly"—will not a nation seek out its God? Why do they seek out the dead concerning the living?
verses.8:20: For He gave a law for help, so that they might speak not like this word, concerning which there are no gifts to give for it.
verses.8:21: And a severe famine will come upon you, and it will happen when you grow hungry, you will be grieved and speak evil of the ruler and the ancestral customs, and they will look up to heaven above,
verses.8:22: and look down at the earth below; and look, narrow perplexity and darkness, affliction and distress and darkness so as not to see, and the one who is in distress will not be at a loss until a time.
verses.8:23: Drink this first, act quickly, country of Zebulun, the land of Naphtali, and the rest, those along the seacoast and beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
verses.9:1: People walking in darkness, see a great light; you who dwell in a land, a shadow of death, light will shine upon you.
verses.9:2: The greater part of the people whom You brought down in Your joy—they will rejoice before You like those who rejoice in harvest, and just as those who divide spoils.
verses.9:3: For the yoke lying upon them has been taken away, and the rod that was upon their neck; for He shattered the rod of the exactors, as in the day against Midian.
verses.9:4: For every robe amassed by deceit, and cloak with recompense, they will pay back, and they will wish that they had been burned with fire.
verses.9:5: For a child was born to us, a son was given to us, whose rule came to be upon His shoulder, and His name is called Messenger of Great Counsel; for I will bring peace upon the rulers and health to Him.
verses.9:6: Great is His rule, and of His peace there is no boundary, upon the throne of David and his kingdom, to set it upright and sustain it in judgment and in righteousness, from now on and forever; the zeal of the Lord Sabaoth will do these things.
verses.9:7: The Lord sent death upon Jacob, and it came upon Israel.
verses.9:8: And all the people of Ephraim and those residing in Samaria will know, who say in arrogance and a lofty heart,
verses.9:9: "Bricks have fallen, but come, let us hew stones, and let us cut down sycamores and cedars, and let us build a tower for ourselves."
verses.9:10: And God will dash upon him those who rise up against Mount Zion, and He will scatter the enemies,
verses.9:11: Syria from the rising of the sun and the Greeks from the setting of the sun, who devour Israel with a full mouth. For all these things the fury has not turned away, but the hand is still uplifted.
verses.9:12: And the people did not turn back until they were struck, and they did not seek the Lord.
verses.9:13: And the Lord took away from Israel head and tail, great and small in one day, an elder and those who admire faces—this is the beginning,
verses.9:14: and a prophet teaching lawless things—this one is the tail.
verses.9:15: And those who call this people blessed will be leading them astray, and they lead astray so that they may swallow them up.
verses.9:16: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, and He will not have mercy on their orphans and their widows; for all are lawless and wicked, and every mouth speaks unjust things. For all these things the fury has not turned away, but the hand is still uplifted.
verses.9:17: And lawlessness will burn like fire, and like dry grass it will be eaten by fire; and it will burn in the thickets of the forest, and it will devour together everything around the hills;
verses.9:18: because of the fury of the wrath of the Lord, the whole land has been burned up, and the people will be as though burned up by fire. A man will not have mercy on his brother,
verses.9:19: but he will turn aside to the right, because he will be hungry, and he will eat from the left, and a man eating the flesh of his arm will by no means be filled.
verses.9:20: For Manasseh will eat of Ephraim, and Ephraim of Manasseh, because together they will besiege Judah. For all these things the fury has not turned away, but the hand is still uplifted.
verses.10:1: Woe to those who write wickedness; for writing, they write wickedness,
verses.10:2: turning aside the justice of the poor, seizing the judgment of the needy of My people, so that a widow becomes prey for them, and an orphan becomes plunder.
verses.10:3: And what will they do in the day of visitation? For affliction will come to you from afar; and to whom will you flee for refuge to be helped? And where will you leave your glory behind so as not to fall into captivity?
verses.10:4: For all these things the wrath has not turned away, but the hand is still uplifted.
verses.10:5: Woe to the Assyrians, the rod of My fury, and the wrath is in their hands.
verses.10:6: I will send My wrath against a lawless nation, and I will command My people to take spoils and plunder, and to trample the cities and turn them into dust.
verses.10:7: But he did not think so, and in his soul he has not reasoned so; rather, his mind will change, even to destroy not a few nations.
verses.10:8: And if they say to him, "You alone are ruler,"
verses.10:9: then he will say, "Did I not take the region above Babylon and Calneh, where the tower was built? And I took Arabia and Damascus and Samaria;
verses.10:10: just as I took these, I will also take all the realms. Wail, you carved images in Jerusalem and in Samaria;
verses.10:11: for just as I did to Samaria and to its things made with hands, so I will do also to Jerusalem and to its idols."
verses.10:12: And it will be, when the Lord finishes doing everything on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, He will bring punishment upon the great mind, upon the ruler of the Assyrians, and upon the loftiness of the glory of his eyes.
verses.10:13: For he said, "By strength I will act, and by the wisdom of understanding I will remove boundaries of nations, and I will plunder their strength;
verses.10:14: and I will shake inhabited cities, and I will seize the whole inhabited world with my hand like a nest, and like abandoned eggs I will take them up; and there is no one who will escape me or speak against me."
verses.10:15: Will an axe be glorified without the one who chops with it? Or will a saw be lifted up without the one who pulls it? As when someone lifts up a rod or a piece of wood—and is it not so?
verses.10:16: But the Lord Sabaoth will send upon your honor dishonor, and upon your glory a burning fire will burn;
verses.10:17: and the light of Israel will become fire, and will sanctify him in burning fire, and will devour the brushwood like grass.
verses.10:18: On that day the mountains and the hills and the forests will be extinguished, and it will devour from soul even to flesh; and the one who flees will be like one fleeing from a burning flame;
verses.10:19: and those who are left from them will be a number, and a child will write them down.
verses.10:20: And it will be on that day, what is left of Israel will no longer be added to, and those of Jacob who were saved will no longer trust in those who wronged them, but they will trust in God, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
verses.10:21: And what is left of Jacob will be upon a mighty God.
verses.10:22: And even if the people of Israel become like the sand of the sea, their remnant will be saved;
verses.10:23: completing and cutting short a word in righteousness, because the Lord will execute a word cut short in the whole inhabited world.
verses.10:24: Therefore thus says the Lord Sabaoth: "Do not be afraid, My people who dwell in Zion, of the Assyrians, because he will strike you with a rod; for I am bringing a blow upon you, to see the way of Egypt.
verses.10:25: For yet a little while, and the wrath will cease, and My fury will be against their counsel."
verses.10:26: And God will stir up against them according to the blow of Midian in a place of affliction, and His fury on the way by the sea, into the way toward Egypt.
verses.10:27: And it will be on that day his yoke will be taken away from your shoulder, and the fear of him from you, and the yoke will be destroyed from your shoulders.
verses.10:28: For he will come to the city of Aggai, and he will pass on to Megiddo, and in Michmash he will deposit his baggage;
verses.10:29: and he will pass through a ravine and he will come to Aggai; fear will seize Ramah, the city of Saul. She will flee,
verses.10:30: the daughter of Gallim; she will listen in Sa, she will listen in Anathoth;
verses.10:31: and Madebena was dismayed, and those who dwell in Gibbir.
verses.10:32: Exhort today on the road to remain; with your hand exhort the mountain, the daughter of Zion, and you hills that are in Jerusalem.
verses.10:33: Look, the Master, the Lord Sabaoth, throws the glorious ones into confusion with strength, and those who are lofty in arrogance will be crushed, and the lofty will be humbled,
verses.10:34: and lofty ones will fall by the sword, and Lebanon will fall with the lofty ones.
verses.11:1: And a rod will come forth from the root of Jesse, and a blossom will come up from the root.
verses.11:2: And the Spirit of God will rest upon Him, a spirit of wisdom and understanding, a spirit of counsel and strength, a spirit of knowledge and godliness;
verses.11:3: a spirit of the fear of God will fill Him. He will not judge according to appearance, nor will He reprove according to report,
verses.11:4: but He will judge judgment for a humble one, and He will reprove the humble of the earth, and He will strike the earth with the word of His mouth, and with breath through His lips He will kill an ungodly one;
verses.11:5: and He will be girded around His waist with righteousness, and wrapped around His sides with truth.
verses.11:6: And a wolf will graze together with a lamb, and a leopard will rest together with a young goat, and a calf and a bull and a lion will graze together, and a small child will lead them;
verses.11:7: and an ox and a bear will graze together, and their young will be together, and a lion like an ox will eat straw;
verses.11:8: and an infant child over holes of asps, even upon a den of the offspring of asps will lay its hand.
verses.11:9: And they will by no means do harm, nor will they be able to destroy anyone upon My holy mountain, because the entire earth has been filled with knowing the Lord, as much water covers seas.
verses.11:10: And it will be on that day, the root of Jesse and the One who rises up to rule nations—in Him nations will hope; and His resting place will be honor.
verses.11:11: And it will be on that day the Lord will again show His hand to be zealous for the remaining remnant of the people, whatever is left by the Assyrians and from Egypt and from Babylonia and Ethiopia and from the Elamites and from the rising of the sun and from Arabia.
verses.11:12: And He will lift up a signal to the nations, and He will gather together the lost ones of Israel, and He will gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four wings of the earth.
verses.11:13: And the jealousy of Ephraim will be taken away, and the enemies of Judah will perish; Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah, and Judah will not afflict Ephraim.
verses.11:14: And they will fly in ships of foreigners; together they will plunder the sea and those from the rising of the sun and Idumea, and upon Moab first they will lay their hands, and the sons of Ammon will obey first.
verses.11:15: And the Lord will make desolate the sea of Egypt, and He will lay His hand upon the river with a violent wind, and He will strike seven ravines so that it may be crossed in sandals;
verses.11:16: and there will be a passageway for My people who are left in Egypt, and it will be for Israel like the day when it came out from the land of Egypt.
verses.12:1: And you will say in that day, "I bless You, Lord, because You were angry with me, and You turned away Your fury and had mercy on me.
verses.12:2: Look, my God is my Savior; I will have confidence in Him and will not be afraid, because the Lord is my glory and my praise, and He has become salvation for me."
verses.12:3: And you will draw water with gladness from the springs of salvation.
verses.12:4: And you will say in that day, "Sing praise to the Lord, call out His name, declare His glorious deeds among the nations; remember that His name has been exalted.
verses.12:5: Sing praise to the name of the Lord, because He has done lofty things; declare these things in all the earth.
verses.12:6: Exult and be glad, you who inhabit Zion, because the Holy One of Israel has been exalted in her midst."
verses.13:1: A vision that Isaiah son of Amoz saw against Babylon.
verses.13:2: On a level mountain lift up a signal, raise your voice to them, summon with the hand; open, you rulers.
verses.13:3: I command them, even I; giants are coming to fulfill My fury, rejoicing and behaving arrogantly at the same time.
verses.13:4: A sound of many nations on the mountains, like that of many nations, a sound of kings and nations gathered together. The Lord Sabaoth has commanded a warrior nation
verses.13:5: to come from a land far away, from the farthest foundation of heaven, the Lord and His warriors, to destroy the whole inhabited world.
verses.13:6: Wail, for the day of the Lord is near, and destruction from God will come.
verses.13:7: Therefore every hand will go limp, and every human soul will be afraid;
verses.13:8: the envoys will be troubled, and labor pains will seize them like a woman giving birth; and they will lament to one another and be astounded, and they will change their face like a flame.
verses.13:9: For look, the day of the Lord is coming, incurable, of fury and wrath, to make the inhabited world desolate and to destroy the sinners from it.
verses.13:10: For the stars of heaven and Orion and all the array of heaven will not give light, and it will grow dark as the sun rises, and the moon will not give its light.
verses.13:11: And I will command evils upon the whole inhabited world, and their sins upon the ungodly; and I will destroy the arrogance of the lawless, and the arrogance of the proud I will humble.
verses.13:12: And those who are left will be more precious than gold untouched by fire, and a human being will be more precious than the stone that is in Souphir.
verses.13:13: For heaven will become furious, and the earth will be shaken from its foundations because of the fury of the wrath of the Lord Sabaoth, in the day when His fury comes.
verses.13:14: And those who are left will be like a fleeing gazelle and like a straying sheep, and there will be no one gathering them, so that each person turns back to his own people, and each person will rush to his own country.
verses.13:15: For whoever is captured will be defeated, and all who have been gathered together will fall by the sword.
verses.13:16: And they will dash their children down before them, and they will plunder their houses, and they will take their wives.
verses.13:17: Look, I am stirring up the Medes against you, who do not value silver nor have need of gold.
verses.13:18: They will shatter the arrows of young men, and they will certainly not have mercy on your children, nor will their eyes spare your children.
verses.13:19: And Babylon, which is called glorious by the king of the Chaldeans, will be just as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah;
verses.13:20: it will not be inhabited forever, nor will anyone by any means enter it through many generations, nor will Arabs by any means pass through it, nor will shepherds by any means rest in it.
verses.13:21: And wild beasts will rest there, and the houses will be filled with noise; and sirens will rest there, and demons will dance there,
verses.13:22: and onocentaurs will dwell there, and hedgehogs will make nests in their houses. It is coming quickly and will not delay.
verses.14:1: And the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will still choose Israel, and they will rest upon their land; and the proselyte will be joined to them, and will be joined to the house of Jacob,
verses.14:2: and nations will take them and bring them into their place, and they will receive an inheritance, and they will be multiplied upon the land as male servants and female servants; and those who took them captive will be captives, and those who ruled over them will be ruled over.
verses.14:3: And it will be in that day that the Lord will give you rest from your pain and your fury, your hard slavery with which you served them.
verses.14:4: And you will take up this lament over the king of Babylon, and you will say, "How the exactor has rested, and the taskmaster has rested!
verses.14:5: The Lord has shattered the yoke of sinners, the yoke of rulers,
verses.14:6: having struck a nation in fury with an incurable blow, beating a nation with a blow of fury that did not spare, He rested confident.
verses.14:7: The whole earth shouts with gladness,
verses.14:8: and the trees of Lebanon were glad over you, and the cedar of Lebanon: 'Since you have fallen asleep, the one who cuts us down has not come up.'
verses.14:9: Hades below was embittered at meeting you; all the giants who ruled the earth were roused together for you, who raised up from their thrones all the kings of nations.
verses.14:10: All will answer and say to you, 'You too have been captured just as we were, and you have been counted among us.'
verses.14:11: Your glory has gone down to Hades, your great gladness; beneath you they will spread decay, and your covering is the worm.
verses.14:12: How the morning star, who rises early, has fallen out of heaven! He who sent to all the nations has been shattered to the earth.
verses.14:13: But you said in your mind, 'I will ascend into heaven; above the stars of heaven I will set my throne; I will sit on a high mountain, upon the high mountains toward the north;
verses.14:14: I will ascend above the clouds; I will be like the Most High.'
verses.14:15: Now, however, you will go down to Hades and to the foundations of the earth.
verses.14:16: Those who see you will marvel at you and will say, 'This is the man who provoked the earth, shaking kings,
verses.14:17: who made the whole inhabited world desolate, and he tore down his cities; he did not release those in captivity.'
verses.14:18: All the kings of the nations slept in honor, each person in his house;
verses.14:19: but you will be cast out on the mountains, like a loathsome corpse, with many who have died, pierced with swords, going down to Hades.
verses.14:20: Just as a garment stained with blood will not be clean, so neither will you be clean, because you destroyed my land and killed my people; you will by no means remain forever, evil seed.
verses.14:21: Prepare your children to be slaughtered for the sins of their father, so that they may not rise up and inherit the earth and fill the earth with wars."
verses.14:22: "And I will rise up against them," says the Lord Sabaoth, "and I will destroy their name and remnant and seed," thus says the Lord.
verses.14:23: "And I will make Babylonia desolate so that hedgehogs dwell there, and it will become nothing; and I will make it a pit of mud for destruction."
verses.14:24: Thus says the Lord Sabaoth: "Just as I have spoken, so it will be, and just as I have planned, so it will remain,
verses.14:25: to destroy the Assyrians on My land and on My mountains; and they will be for trampling, and their yoke will be taken away from them, and their renown will be taken away from their shoulders."
verses.14:26: This is the plan that the Lord has planned against the whole inhabited world, and this is the uplifted hand against all the nations.
verses.14:27: For what the holy God has planned, who will thwart? And His uplifted hand, who will turn back?
verses.14:28: In the year in which King Ahaz died, this word came.
verses.14:29: May you not be glad, all you foreigners, for the yoke of the one beating you has been shattered; for from the seed of a serpent will come forth offspring of asps, and their offspring will come forth as flying serpents.
verses.14:30: And the poor will be pastured through him, and poor people will rest in peace; but he will kill your seed with famine, and your remnant he will kill.
verses.14:31: Wail, gates of cities; let troubled cities cry out, all you foreigners, because smoke is coming from the north, and there is no way to exist.
verses.14:32: And what will the kings of the nations answer? That the Lord has founded Zion, and through Him the humble of the people will be saved.
verses.15:1: The word against Moabitis. By night Moabitis will be destroyed, for by night the wall of Moabitis will be destroyed.
verses.15:2: Grieve for yourselves, for Dibon also will be destroyed, where your altar is; there you will go up to weep, to Nebo of Moabitis. Wail; on every head is baldness, all arms are gashed;
verses.15:3: in her squares wrap yourselves in sackcloth, and lament on her rooftops and in her streets; all of you, wail with weeping.
verses.15:4: Because Heshbon and Elealeh have cried aloud, their voice was heard as far as Jahaz; therefore the loins of Moabitis cry out, her soul will know.
verses.15:5: The heart of Moabitis cries out within her as far as Zoar, for she is a three-year-old heifer; and up the ascent of Luhith they will go up to you weeping along the road of Horonaim; destruction and shaking cry out,
verses.15:6: the water of Nimrim will be a desolation, and its grass will fail; for there will be no green grass.
verses.15:7: Is she going to be saved even like this? For I will bring Arabs upon the ravine, and they will take it.
verses.15:8: For the outcry has reached the border of Moabitis, of Eglaim, and her wailing as far as the well of Elim.
verses.15:9: And the water of Dimon will be filled with blood; for I will bring Arabs upon Dimon, and I will remove the seed of Moab and Ariel and the remnant of Adama.
verses.16:1: I will send like creeping things upon the earth; is the mountain of the daughter of Zion a desolate rock?
verses.16:2: For you will be like a nestling taken away from a bird flying away; you will be, daughter of Moab; on this side, Arnon, further
verses.16:3: take counsel, make a shelter of mourning for her continually; in midday darkness they flee, they are bewildered; do not be led away.
verses.16:4: The fugitives of Moab will sojourn with you; they will be a shelter for you from the presence of a pursuer, because your alliance has been removed, and the ruler who tramples down has perished from the earth.
verses.16:5: And a throne will be set upright with mercy, and one will sit on it with truth in the tent of David, judging and seeking out justice and hastening righteousness.
verses.16:6: We have heard of the arrogance of Moab; he is exceedingly arrogant; I have removed the pride. Not so is your divination, not so.
verses.16:7: Moab will wail, for in Moabitis all will wail; you will be concerned for those who inhabit Deseth, and you will not be ashamed.
verses.16:8: The fields of Heshbon will mourn, the vine of Sibmah; you who swallow up the nations, you will trample down its vines as far as Jazer; you will by no means catch up, wander the wilderness; those who were sent were abandoned, for they crossed the sea.
verses.16:9: Therefore I will weep, like the weeping of Jazer, for the vine of Sibmah; Heshbon and Elealeh struck down your trees, because upon your harvest and upon your vintage I will trample, and all things will fall.
verses.16:10: And gladness and exultation will be removed from the vineyards, and in your vineyards they will by no means be glad, and they will by no means tread wine into the wine vats, for it has ceased.
verses.16:11: Therefore my belly will resound like a harp over Moab, and my inward parts you renewed like a wall.
verses.16:12: And it will result in your being ashamed, because Moab grew weary at the altars and will enter into its handmade things to pray, and they will by no means be able to rescue it.
verses.16:13: This is the word that the Lord spoke concerning Moab, when He spoke.
verses.16:14: And now I say, "In three years of the years of a hired worker, the glory of Moab will be dishonored with all the great wealth, and it will be left very small in number and not honored."
verses.17:1: The word against Damascus. Look, Damascus will be removed from among cities, and it will become a ruin,
verses.17:2: abandoned forever, for a resting place of flocks and for rest, and there will be no one pursuing;
verses.17:3: and there will no longer be a stronghold for Ephraim to take refuge, and no longer a kingdom in Damascus nor the remainder of the Syrians; for you are no better than the sons of Israel and their glory. Thus says the Lord Sabaoth:
verses.17:4: "In that day there will be a failing of the glory of Jacob, and the rich parts of his glory will be shaken.
verses.17:5: And it will be just as when someone gathers a standing harvest and reaps seed of heads of grain, and it will be just as when someone gathers a head of grain in a hard ravine,
verses.17:6: and stubble is left in it, or like two or three olive berries on a lofty top, or four or five are left on their branches." Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel.
verses.17:7: On that day man will trust in the One who made him, and his eyes will look to the Holy One of Israel,
verses.17:8: and they will by no means trust in the altars nor in the works of their hands, which their fingers made, and they will not look upon the trees nor their abominations.
verses.17:9: On that day your cities will be abandoned, just as the Amorites and the Hivites abandoned them from the presence of the sons of Israel, and they will be desolate;
verses.17:10: because you abandoned God your Savior, and you did not remember the Lord your Helper. Therefore you will plant an unfaithful planting and an unfaithful seed;
verses.17:11: but on the day that you plant, you will go astray; and in the morning, if you sow, it will blossom for harvest on whatever day you inherit, and like a father of a man you will allot an inheritance to your sons.
verses.17:12: Woe, multitude of many nations; like a surging sea, so you will be thrown into turmoil, and the back of many nations will resound like water;
verses.17:13: like much water are many nations, like much water driven by force. And He will cast him off, and will pursue him far away like fine chaff of those who winnow before the wind, and like dust of a wheel that a whirlwind carries.
verses.17:14: Toward evening there will be mourning; before morning he will be no more. This is the portion of those who plundered you, and an inheritance for those who inherited you.
verses.18:1: Woe, wings of a land of ships beyond the rivers of Ethiopia,
verses.18:2: the one who sends hostages on the sea and papyrus letters upon the water. For swift messengers will go to a lofty nation, and a strange and harsh people; who is beyond it? A nation without hope and trampled. Now the rivers of the earth
verses.18:3: will all be inhabited like an inhabited country; their country may be lifted up as for a signal from a mountain; like the sound of a trumpet, it will be audible.
verses.18:4: Because thus the Lord said to me, "Security will be in My city like a light of burning heat at midday, and it will be like a cloud of dew on a day of reaping.
verses.18:5: Before the harvest, when the blossom is finished and an unripe grape will put forth a blossom while forming unripe grapes; and He will remove the small grape clusters with the pruning hooks, and the shoots He will remove and cut off,
verses.18:6: and He will leave them together to the birds of the sky and the wild beasts of the earth; and the birds of the sky will be gathered together upon them, and all the wild beasts of the earth will come upon him."
verses.18:7: At that time gifts will be brought up to the Lord Sabaoth from an afflicted and plucked people, and from a great people from now on and forever, a nation that hopes and is trampled, which is in a part of a river of its country, to the place where the name of the Lord Sabaoth is, Mount Zion.
verses.19:1: A vision of Egypt. Look, the Lord is sitting on a swift cloud and will come into Egypt, and the handmade things of Egypt will be shaken before His presence, and their heart will be defeated within them.
verses.19:2: And Egyptians will be stirred up against Egyptians, and a man will fight against his brother and a man against his neighbor, city against city and district against district.
verses.19:3: And the spirit of the Egyptians will be troubled within them, and I will scatter their counsel; and they will inquire of their gods and their images and those who speak from the ground and the mediums.
verses.19:4: And I will deliver Egypt into the hands of men, harsh masters, and harsh kings will rule over them. Thus says the Lord Sabaoth.
verses.19:5: And the Egyptians will drink the water beside the sea, and the river will fail and be dried up;
verses.19:6: and the rivers and the canals of the river will fail, and every gathering of water will be dried up, and in every marsh of reed and papyrus,
verses.19:7: and all the green reed-grass around the river and what is sown along the river will be dried up, wind-blasted.
verses.19:8: And the fishermen will groan, and all who cast hooks into the river will groan, and those who cast dragnets and the net-casters will mourn.
verses.19:9: And shame will seize those who work split flax and those who work fine linen,
verses.19:10: and those who work them will be in pain, and all who make beer will be grieved and will ache in their souls.
verses.19:11: And the rulers of Tanis will be fools; the wise counselors of the king—their counsel will be made foolish. How will you say to the king, "We are sons of the discerning, sons of kings from the beginning"?
verses.19:12: Where are your wise men now? And let them declare to you and say what the Lord Sabaoth has purposed against Egypt.
verses.19:13: The rulers of Tanis have failed, and the rulers of Memphis have been exalted; and they will lead Egypt astray by tribes.
verses.19:14: For the Lord mixed for them a spirit of error, and they led Egypt astray in all their works, as the one who is drunk and the one who vomits stagger together.
verses.19:15: And there will be no work for the Egyptians that will make head and tail, and beginning and end.
verses.19:16: Now on that day the Egyptians will be like women in fear and in trembling before the hand of the Lord Sabaoth, which He Himself will lay upon them.
verses.19:17: And the land of the Judeans will be a terror to the Egyptians; everyone who mentions it to them—they will be afraid because of the counsel that the Lord has purposed against it.
verses.19:18: On that day there will be five cities in Egypt speaking the Canaanite language and swearing by the name of the Lord; the one city will be called City of Asedek.
verses.19:19: On that day there will be an altar to the Lord in the land of the Egyptians, and a pillar at its border to the Lord,
verses.19:20: and it will be for a sign forever to the Lord in the land of Egypt; for they will cry out to the Lord because of those who afflict them, and He will send them a man who will save them; judging, he will save them.
verses.19:21: And the Lord will be known to the Egyptians, and the Egyptians will know the Lord on that day, and they will offer sacrifices, and they will vow vows to the Lord and fulfill them.
verses.19:22: And the Lord will strike the Egyptians with a blow, and He will heal them with healing; and they will return to the Lord, and He will listen to them and heal them.
verses.19:23: On that day there will be the road of Egypt to the Assyrians, and Assyrians will enter into Egypt, and Egyptians will go to the Assyrians, and Egyptians will serve the Assyrians.
verses.19:24: On that day Israel will be third among the Egyptians and among the Assyrians, blessed in the land
verses.19:25: that the Lord Sabaoth blessed, saying, "Blessed is My people that is in Egypt and that is among the Assyrians, and the land, My inheritance, Israel."
verses.20:1: In the year when Tanathan entered into Ashdod, when he was sent by Arna, king of the Assyrians, and he fought against Ashdod and took it,
verses.20:2: then the Lord spoke to Isaiah son of Amoz, saying, "Go and remove the sackcloth from your waist, and untie your sandals from your feet, and do so, going naked and barefoot."
verses.20:3: And the Lord said, "Just as My servant Isaiah has gone naked and barefoot for three years, three years will be for signs and wonders to the Egyptians and Ethiopians;
verses.20:4: for thus the king of the Assyrians will lead the captives of Egypt and of the Ethiopians, young men and old men, naked and barefoot alike, having the shame of Egypt covered.
verses.20:5: And having been defeated, they will be ashamed over the Ethiopians, in whom the Egyptians had trusted, who were a glory to them.
verses.20:6: And those who dwell on this island will say on that day, 'Look, we had trusted to flee to them for help, who were not able to be saved from the king of the Assyrians; and how will we be saved?'"
verses.21:1: The vision of the wilderness. As a storm might pass through a wilderness, coming from a wilderness, out of a land. Fearful
verses.21:2: is the vision, and harsh, that was announced to me. The treacherous one acts treacherously, the lawless one acts lawlessly. Against me are the Elamites, and the envoys of the Persians are coming against me. Now I will groan and comfort myself.
verses.21:3: Because of this my loins were filled with faintness, and birth pangs seized me like a woman giving birth; I did wrong not to hear, I hurried not to see.
verses.21:4: My heart wanders, and lawlessness overwhelms me; my soul stands in fear.
verses.21:5: Prepare the table, eat, drink; rise up, you rulers, prepare shields,
verses.21:6: for thus the Lord said to me: "Go, station a lookout for yourself, and whatever you see, announce."
verses.21:7: And I saw two mounted horsemen, and a rider of a donkey, and a rider of a camel. Listen with great attention,
verses.21:8: and call Uriah to the lookout post. The Lord said, "I stood continually by day, and at the camp I stood all the night,
verses.21:9: and look, he himself is coming, a rider of a two-horse chariot." And answering he said, "Fallen, fallen is Babylon, and all her statues and her handmade things were shattered to the ground."
verses.21:10: Hear, you who are left behind and you who are in pain, hear what I heard from the Lord Sabaoth; the God of Israel has announced it to us.
verses.21:11: The vision of Idumea. To me someone calls from Seir, "Guard the battlements."
verses.21:12: I guard morning and night; if you seek, seek, and dwell with me;
verses.21:13: in the forest at evening you will sleep, on the road of Dedan.
verses.21:14: To meet one who is thirsty, bring water, you who live in the land of Teman; with loaves, meet those who are fleeing
verses.21:15: because of the multitude of those killed, and because of the multitude of those wandering, and because of the multitude of the sword, and because of the multitude of the drawn bows, and because of the multitude of those who have fallen in the war.
verses.21:16: Because thus the Lord said to me: "Yet a year, like a year of a hired worker, the glory of the sons of Kedar will fail,
verses.21:17: and the remainder of the bows of the mighty sons of Kedar will be small," for the Lord, the God of Israel, has spoken.
verses.22:1: The word of the valley of Zion. What has happened to you that now you have all gone up onto vain rooftops?
verses.22:2: The city was filled with those shouting; your wounded are not wounded by swords, nor are your dead, dead by war.
verses.22:3: All your rulers have fled, and having been captured, they are harshly bound; and those who are strong in you have fled far away.
verses.22:4: Because of this I said, "Leave me alone, I will weep bitterly; do not insist on comforting me over the shattering of the daughter of my people."
verses.22:5: For it is a day of turmoil and destruction, and trampling and wandering, from the Lord Sabaoth; in the valley of Zion they wander, from small to great they wander upon the mountains.
verses.22:6: And the Elamites took quivers, men mounted on horses, and a gathering of battle-array.
verses.22:7: And your choice valleys will be—they will be filled with chariots, and the horsemen will block your gates,
verses.22:8: and they will uncover the gates of Judah; and they will look in that day into the choice houses of the city,
verses.22:9: and they will uncover the hidden things of the houses of the citadel of David. And they saw that they are many, and that he turned back the water of the ancient pool into the city,
verses.22:10: and that they tore down the houses of Jerusalem for fortifications of a wall for the city.
verses.22:11: And you made for yourselves water between the two walls, inside the ancient pool, and you did not look to the One who made it from the beginning, and the One who created it you did not see.
verses.22:12: And the Lord, the Lord Sabaoth, called in that day for weeping and lamentation and shaving and girding with sackcloth,
verses.22:13: but they made gladness and exultation, slaughtering calves and sacrificing sheep, so as to eat meat and drink wine: "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die."
verses.22:14: And these things are uncovered in the ears of the Lord Sabaoth, that this sin will not be forgiven you until you die.
verses.22:15: Thus says the Lord Sabaoth: "Go into the chamber to Shebna the treasurer and say to him,
verses.22:16: 'Why are you here, and what do you have here, that you have hewed out a tomb for yourself here, and made a tomb for yourself on high, and carved a tent for yourself in a rock?
verses.22:17: Look now, the Lord Sabaoth casts out and will crush a man, and He will remove your robe and your glorious crown,
verses.22:18: and He will hurl you into a large and measureless land, and there you will die; and He will put your fine chariot to dishonor, and the house of your ruler,
verses.22:19: and you will be removed from your stewardship and from your station.
verses.22:20: And it will be in that day that I will call My servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,
verses.22:21: and I will clothe him with your robe, and your crown I will give to him with power, and your stewardship I will give into his hands; and he will be like a father to those who live in Jerusalem and to those who live in Judah.
verses.22:22: And I will give the glory of David to him, and he will rule, and there will be no one who opposes, and he will shut, and there is no one who opens.
verses.22:23: And I will establish him as a ruler in a faithful place, and he will become a throne of glory of the house of his father.
verses.22:24: And every glorious one in the house of his father will be trusting in him, from small to great, and they will be hanging upon him
verses.22:25: in that day.'" Thus says the Lord Sabaoth: "The man who has been firmly fixed in a faithful place will be moved, and he will be removed and will fall, and the glory that is upon him will be utterly destroyed," for the Lord has spoken.
verses.23:1: The word of Tyre. Wail, ships of Carthage, for she has perished, and they no longer come from the land of the Citians; she has been led away captive.
verses.23:2: To whom have those who live on the island become like, traders of Phoenicia, crossing over the sea
verses.23:3: in much water, seed of traders? Like a harvest being brought in are the traders of the nations.
verses.23:4: "Be ashamed, Sidon," said the sea; and the strength of the sea said, "I was not in labor, nor did I give birth, nor did I rear young men, nor raise up virgins."
verses.23:5: And when it is heard by Egypt, pain will seize them concerning Tyre.
verses.23:6: Go away to Carthage; wail, you who dwell on this island.
verses.23:7: Was this not your insolence from the beginning, before she was handed over?
verses.23:8: Who planned these things against Tyre? Surely she is not inferior, or is she not strong? Her merchants are glorious, rulers of the earth.
verses.23:9: The Lord Sabaoth planned to undo all the insolence of the glorious ones, and to dishonor every glorious thing upon the earth.
verses.23:10: Work your land, for ships no longer come from Carthage.
verses.23:11: And your hand is no longer strong over the sea, which provokes kings; the Lord Sabaoth has commanded concerning Canaan to destroy her strength.
verses.23:12: And they will say, "You will by no means continue to treat insolently and wrong the daughter of Sidon; and if you go away to the Citians, not even there will there be rest for you;
verses.23:13: and to the land of the Chaldeans—even it has been made desolate by the Assyrians; its wall has fallen."
verses.23:14: Wail, ships of Carthage, for your stronghold has perished.
verses.23:15: And it will be in that day that Tyre will be forsaken for seventy years, like the time of a king, like the time of a man; and it will be after seventy years that Tyre will be like the song of a prostitute.
verses.23:16: Take a harp, roam about, forgotten prostitute city; play the harp well, sing many songs, so that there may be remembrance of you.
verses.23:17: And it will be after the seventy years that God will make a visitation of Tyre, and again she will be restored to the ancient state, and she will be a marketplace for all the kingdoms of the inhabited world upon the face of the earth.
verses.23:18: And her trade and wages will be holy to the Lord; it will not be gathered for them, but for those who dwell before the Lord, all her trade, to eat and to drink and to be filled, and for a contribution, a memorial before the Lord.
verses.24:1: Look, the Lord is destroying the inhabited world, and will lay it waste and uncover its face and scatter those who dwell in it.
verses.24:2: And the people will be like the priest, and the servant like the master, and the maidservant like the mistress; the one who buys will be like the one who sells, the one who lends like the one who borrows, and the one who owes like the one to whom he owes.
verses.24:3: With destruction the earth will be destroyed, and with plunder the earth will be plundered; for the mouth of the Lord has spoken these things.
verses.24:4: The earth mourned, and the inhabited world was destroyed; the lofty ones of the earth mourned.
verses.24:5: And the earth acted lawlessly because of those who inhabit it, because they transgressed the law and changed the ordinances, an eternal covenant.
verses.24:6: Therefore a curse will devour the earth, because those who inhabit it sinned; therefore those who dwell on the earth will be poor, and few people will be left.
verses.24:7: Wine will mourn, the vine will mourn; all who are glad in soul will groan.
verses.24:8: The gladness of tambourines has ceased, the arrogance and wealth of the ungodly has ceased, the sound of the lyre has ceased.
verses.24:9: They were put to shame; they did not drink wine; strong drink became bitter to those who drink it.
verses.24:10: Every city was laid waste; one will shut a house so that no one may enter.
verses.24:11: Wail over the wine everywhere; all gladness has ceased.
verses.24:12: Cities will be left desolate, and abandoned houses will perish.
verses.24:13: All these things will be on the earth in the midst of the nations: just as when someone gleans an olive tree, so they will glean them, and when the grape harvest has ceased.
verses.24:14: These will cry out with a shout, but those who are left on the earth will be glad together with the glory of the Lord; the water of the sea will be troubled.
verses.24:15: Therefore the glory of the Lord will be in the islands of the sea; the name of the Lord will be glorious.
verses.24:16: Lord, God of Israel, from the wings of the earth we have heard wonders: "Hope for the godly!" And they will say, "Woe to those who rebel!" You who rebel against the law,
verses.24:17: fear and a pit and a snare are upon you who dwell on the earth.
verses.24:18: And it will be that the one who flees from the fear will fall into the pit, and the one who comes out of the pit will be caught by the snare; for windows from heaven were opened, and the foundations of the earth will be shaken.
verses.24:19: With trouble the earth will be troubled, and with perplexity the earth will be perplexed.
verses.24:20: It tilted like one who is drunk and reeling, and the earth will be shaken like a fruit-watcher's hut; for lawlessness prevailed upon it, and it will fall and will by no means be able to rise.
verses.24:21: And God will bring His hand upon the array of heaven and upon the kings of the earth.
verses.24:22: And they will gather its gathering into a prison and shut them up in a stronghold; after many generations there will be a visitation of them.
verses.24:23: And the brick will melt, and the wall will fall; for the Lord will reign from Zion and to Jerusalem, and before the elders He will be glorified.
verses.25:1: Lord God, I will glorify You, I will sing praise to Your name, because You did wonderful things, an ancient, true counsel; may it be so.
verses.25:2: For You made cities into a mound, fortified cities so that their foundations might not fall; the city of the ungodly will by no means be built for eternity.
verses.25:3: Therefore the poor people will bless You, and cities of wronged people will bless You.
verses.25:4: For You became a helper to every humble city, and a shelter to those who lost heart because of need; from wicked people You will rescue them—a shelter of those who thirst, and a spirit of wronged people,
verses.25:5: like fainthearted people thirsting in Zion because of ungodly people, to whom You handed us over.
verses.25:6: And the Lord Sabaoth will act for all the nations; on this mountain they will drink gladness, they will drink wine;
verses.25:7: they will anoint themselves with ointment on this mountain. Hand over all these things to the nations, for this counsel is upon all the nations.
verses.25:8: Death, having prevailed, swallowed up, and again the Lord God took away every tear from every face; the reproach of the people He took away from all the earth, for the mouth of the Lord has spoken.
verses.25:9: And they will say on that day, "Here is our God, in whom we were hoping, and He will save us; this is the Lord—we waited for Him and exulted, and we will be glad in our salvation."
verses.25:10: God will give rest upon this mountain, and the Moabite land will be trampled down just as they trample a threshing floor with wagons;
verses.25:11: and he will relax his hands, just as he himself brought low in order to destroy, and He will bring low his arrogance over the things on which he laid his hands;
verses.25:12: and the height of the refuge of your wall He will bring low, and they will come down to the ground.
verses.26:1: On that day they will sing this song in the land of Judea: "Look, a strong city! And He will set salvation as the wall and outer wall.
verses.26:2: Open gates! Let a people enter that keeps righteousness and keeps truth,
verses.26:3: holding fast to truth and keeping peace; for in You, with hope,
verses.26:4: they have hoped, Lord, forever, the great, eternal God,
verses.26:5: who brought low and brought down those who dwell in high places; fortified cities You will cast down and bring down to the ground,
verses.26:6: and the feet of the gentle and humble will trample them.
verses.26:7: The way of the godly has become straight; the way of the godly is also prepared.
verses.26:8: For the way of the Lord is judgment; we have hoped in Your name and in the remembrance
verses.26:9: for which our soul longs. Out of the night my spirit rises early to You, God, because Your ordinances are light upon the earth. Learn righteousness, you who dwell on the earth.
verses.26:10: For the ungodly has ceased; everyone who will by no means learn righteousness on the earth will by no means practice truth; let the ungodly be taken away, so that he may not see the glory of the Lord.
verses.26:11: Lord, Your arm is high, and they did not know; yet when they come to know, they will be put to shame. Zeal will seize an untaught people, and now fire will devour the adversaries.
verses.26:12: Lord our God, give peace to us, for You have rendered all things to us.
verses.26:13: Take possession of us, Lord; apart from You we know no other; we name Your name.
verses.26:14: But the dead will by no means see life, nor will physicians raise them up; therefore You brought it upon them and destroyed them, and took away every male of them.
verses.26:15: Add evils to them, Lord; add evils to the glorious ones of the earth.
verses.26:16: Lord, in distress I remembered You; in a small distress was Your discipline to us.
verses.26:17: And as the woman in labor draws near to give birth—in her labor pain she cries out—so we became to Your beloved.
verses.26:18: Because of the fear of You, Lord, we conceived and were in labor and gave birth; we made a spirit of Your salvation on the earth, but all who dwell on the earth will fall.
verses.26:19: The dead will rise, and those in the tombs will be raised, and those in the earth will be glad; for the dew that is from You is healing to them, but the land of the ungodly will fall."
verses.26:20: Go, My people, enter into your inner rooms, shut your door, hide yourself for a very little while, until the wrath of the Lord passes by.
verses.26:21: For look, the Lord is bringing wrath from the holy place upon those who dwell on the earth; and the earth will uncover its blood, and will not cover up those who have been killed.
verses.27:1: In that day God will bring the holy and great and strong sword against the dragon, a fleeing serpent, against the dragon, a crooked serpent; He will kill the dragon.
verses.27:2: In that day, a fine vineyard; a desire to begin against her.
verses.27:3: I am a fortified city, a city being besieged; in vain I will water her, for she will be captured by night, and by day a wall will fall.
verses.27:4: There is not one that has not taken hold of her; who will set Me to guard stubble in a field? Because of this hostility I have rejected her. Therefore, because of this the Lord has done everything that He commanded. "I have been burned up,"
verses.27:5: those who dwell in her will cry out, "Let us make peace."
verses.27:6: Those who are coming, children of Jacob, Israel will sprout and blossom, and the inhabited world will be filled with his fruit.
verses.27:7: He will not also be struck just as he himself struck, will he? And as he himself killed, will he be killed like that?
verses.27:8: Fighting and reproaching, He will send them away; were you not devising with the harsh spirit to kill them with a spirit of wrath?
verses.27:9: Therefore the lawlessness of Jacob will be taken away, and this is his blessing, when I take away his sin, when they make all the stones of the altars shattered like fine dust; and their trees will certainly not remain, and their idols will be cut down like a forest far away.
verses.27:10: The inhabited flock will be abandoned, like a forsaken flock; and for a long time it will be for pasture, and there they will rest.
verses.27:11: And after a time there will not be anything green in her because it has dried up. Women coming from a sight, come! For it is not a people having understanding; therefore He who made them will certainly not have compassion on them, nor will He who formed them by any means have mercy.
verses.27:12: And it will be in that day that God will fence in from the canal of the river as far as Rhinocorura; and you, gather the sons of Israel one by one.
verses.27:13: And it will be in that day that they will sound the great trumpet, and those who were lost in the land of the Assyrians and those who were lost in Egypt will come, and they will worship the Lord on the holy mountain, Jerusalem.
verses.28:1: Woe to the crown of arrogance, the hired workers of Ephraim, the flower fallen from glory on the summit of the rich mountain, those who are drunk without wine!
verses.28:2: Look, strong and harsh is the wrath of the Lord, like hail pouring down with no shelter, pouring down with force; like a great abundance of water sweeping away a region, it will make rest for the earth; with hands
verses.28:3: and with feet the crown of arrogance will be trampled down, the hired workers of Ephraim.
verses.28:4: And the flower fallen from the hope of life on the top of the high mountain will be like an early fig; the one who sees it, before taking it into his hand, will want to swallow it.
verses.28:5: In that day the Lord Sabaoth will be the crown of hope, woven of glory, for the remnant of the people;
verses.28:6: they will be left with a spirit of judgment for judgment and strength, restraining from killing.
verses.28:7: For these have erred with wine; they went astray because of strong drink, priest and prophet were beside themselves because of strong drink, they were swallowed up because of wine, they were shaken from drunkenness, they went astray; this is a vision.
verses.28:8: A curse will devour this counsel; for this counsel is on account of greed.
verses.28:9: To whom have we announced evil things, and to whom have we announced a message? Those who have been weaned from milk, those who have been drawn away from the breast.
verses.28:10: Expect affliction upon affliction, hope upon hope, yet a little while, yet a little while,
verses.28:11: on account of contempt of lips, through another tongue, for they will speak to this people,
