verses.28:12: saying to them, "This is the rest for the one who is hungry, and this is the crushing," and they were not willing to listen.
verses.28:13: And the oracle of the Lord will be to them: affliction upon affliction, hope upon hope, yet a little while, yet a little while, so that they may go and fall backward, and they will be crushed and be in danger and be captured.
verses.28:14: Therefore hear the word of the Lord, afflicted men and rulers of this people who are in Jerusalem,
verses.28:15: because you said, "We have made a covenant with Hades, and with death an agreement; if a rushing storm passes through, it will certainly not come upon us; we have made falsehood our hope, and by falsehood we will be sheltered."
verses.28:16: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: "Look, I am placing into the foundations of Zion a costly, chosen, honored cornerstone into her foundations, and the one who believes will certainly not be put to shame.
verses.28:17: And I will set judgment for hope, and My mercy for scales, and those who trust in vain in falsehood; that a storm may not sweep over you,
verses.28:18: nor also take away your covenant of death, and your hope toward Hades will certainly not remain; if a rushing storm comes upon you, you will be trampled down by it.
verses.28:19: Whenever it passes through, it will take you; morning by morning it will pass through by day, and in the night there will be an evil hope."
verses.28:20: Learn to listen, you who are hemmed in: we are not able to fight, and we ourselves are too weak for us to be gathered together.
verses.28:21: Like a mountain of the ungodly the Lord will rise up, and He will be in the valley of Gibeon; with wrath He will do His works, a work of bitterness, and His wrath will deal strangely, and His rottenness is strange.
verses.28:22: And as for you, may you not be glad, nor let your bonds grow strong; because completed and cut-short matters I have heard from the Lord Sabaoth, which He will do upon all the earth.
verses.28:23: Give ear and hear my voice; pay attention and hear my words.
verses.28:24: Will the one who plows plow all day long? Or will he prepare seed before working the ground?
verses.28:25: When he has leveled its surface, does he not then sow a little black cumin and cumin, and again sow wheat, barley, and millet, and spelt in your borders?
verses.28:26: And you will be instructed by the judgment of God, and you will be glad.
verses.28:27: For black cumin is not cleaned with harshness, nor will a wagon wheel roll over the cumin; but black cumin is shaken with a rod, and the cumin
verses.28:28: will be eaten with bread. For I will not be angry with you forever, nor will the voice of My bitterness trample you down.
verses.28:29: And these wonders have gone forth from the Lord Sabaoth; take counsel, lift up vain comfort.
verses.29:1: Woe, Ariel, city against which David fought! Gather produce year upon year; you will eat, for you will eat with Moab.
verses.29:2: For I will afflict Ariel, and her strength and wealth will be Mine.
verses.29:3: And I will circle around against you like David, and I will throw up a palisade around you, and I will set towers around you,
verses.29:4: and your words will be brought low to the earth, and into the earth your words will sink; and your voice will be like those who call out from the earth, and toward the ground your voice will grow weak.
verses.29:5: And the wealth of the ungodly will be like dust from a wall, and the multitude of those who oppress you like chaff carried along, and it will be like an instant, suddenly
verses.29:6: from the Lord Sabaoth; for there will be a visitation with thunder and earthquake and a loud voice, a rushing storm and a devouring flame of fire.
verses.29:7: And like one dreaming in sleep at night will be the wealth of all the nations as many as campaigned against Jerusalem, and all those campaigning against Jerusalem, and all those gathered against her, and those who afflict her.
verses.29:8: And like those who in sleep drink and eat, and when they wake up, the dream is vain; and just as the thirsty one dreams as if drinking, and having woken up, he is still thirsty, and his soul has hoped in vain, so will be the wealth of all the nations as many as campaigned against Mount Zion.
verses.29:9: Grow faint and be beside yourselves; be intoxicated, not from strong drink nor from wine;
verses.29:10: for the Lord has made you drink a spirit of stupor, and He will shut their eyes, and those of their prophets and of their rulers, those who see the hidden things.
verses.29:11: And all these sayings will be to you like the words of the sealed book, which if they give it to a man who knows letters, saying, "Read these things," and he will say, "I cannot read, for it has been sealed."
verses.29:12: And this book will be given into the hands of a man who does not know letters, and someone will say to him, "Read this." And he will say, "I do not know letters."
verses.29:13: And the Lord said, "This people draws near to Me with its mouth, and with their lips they honor Me, yet their heart stays far away from Me; and in vain they worship Me, teaching commandments of men and teachings.
verses.29:14: Therefore, look, I will proceed to remove this people, and I will remove them, and I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and the understanding of the intelligent I will hide."
verses.29:15: Woe to those who make counsel deeply, and their works will be in darkness, and they will say, "Who has seen us? And who will know us, or what we ourselves are doing?"
verses.29:16: Will you not be reckoned like the potter's clay? Will the thing formed say to the One who formed it, "It was not You who formed me"? Or the thing made to the One who made it, "You did not make me with understanding"?
verses.29:17: Not much longer, and Lebanon will be changed like Mount Carmel, and Carmel will be reckoned as a forest.
verses.29:18: And in that day the deaf will hear words of a book, and the eyes of the blind, those in the darkness and those in the gloom, will see,
verses.29:19: and the poor will exult because of the Lord in gladness, and the hopeless among men will be filled with gladness.
verses.29:20: The lawless one has come to an end, and the arrogant one has perished, and those who act lawlessly for evil have been utterly destroyed,
verses.29:21: and those who cause men to sin by a word; and they will make all who reprove in the gates a stumbling block, because they turned aside a righteous man with unjust things.
verses.29:22: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the house of Jacob, whom He set apart from Abraham: "Not now will Jacob be put to shame, nor now will he change his face;
verses.29:23: but when their children see My works, because of Me they will sanctify My name, and they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and they will fear the God of Israel;
verses.29:24: and those who go astray in spirit will know understanding, and those who grumble will learn to obey, and the stammering tongues will learn to speak peace."
verses.30:1: "Woe, apostate children," says the Lord, "you made a plan not through Me, and treaties not through My Spirit, to add sins upon sins,
verses.30:2: who set out to go down to Egypt, yet they did not inquire of Me, to be helped by Pharaoh and to be sheltered by the Egyptians.
verses.30:3: For the shelter of Pharaoh will be for shame to you, and a reproach to those who trust in Egypt.
verses.30:4: For in Tanis there are leaders, evil messengers;
verses.30:5: in vain they will weary themselves toward a people that will not profit them for help, but for shame and reproach."
verses.30:6: The vision of the four-footed beasts in the wilderness. In affliction and anguish: a lion and a lion's cub, from there also asps and offspring of asps, who carried their wealth on donkeys and camels to a nation that will not profit them.
verses.30:7: Egyptians will profit you with futile and empty things; report to them, "This consolation of yours is futile."
verses.30:8: Now therefore, sit down and write these things on a boxwood tablet and in a book, because these things will be for days, in time, and even forever.
verses.30:9: For it is a disobedient people, lying sons who were unwilling to hear the law of God,
verses.30:10: who say to the prophets, "Do not declare to us," and to those who see visions, "Do not speak to us; rather, speak to us and declare to us another delusion,
verses.30:11: and turn us away from this way; remove from us this path, and remove from us the oracle of Israel."
verses.30:12: Therefore, thus says the Holy One of Israel: "Because you disobeyed these words and hoped in falsehood, and because you grumbled and came to trust in this word,
verses.30:13: therefore this sin will be to you like a wall of a fortified city that has been captured, falling at once, whose collapse is present at once;
verses.30:14: and its collapse will be like the breaking of an earthen vessel, fine pieces from a clay jar, so that no shard is found among them in which you will take up fire, and in which you will draw off a little water."
verses.30:15: Thus says the Lord, the Lord, the Holy One of Israel: "When you turn back and groan, then you will be saved, and you will know where you were; when you trusted in futile things, your strength became futile. And you were unwilling to listen,
verses.30:16: but you said, 'On horses we will flee'—therefore you will flee; and, 'On swift riders we will be'—therefore those who pursue you will be swift.
verses.30:17: A thousand will flee because of the voice of one, and because of the voice of five many will flee, until you are left like a mast on a mountain, and like one carrying a banner on a hill."
verses.30:18: And again God will wait to have compassion on you, and because of this He will be exalted to have mercy on you, because the Lord your God is a judge; blessed are those who abide in Him.
verses.30:19: Because a holy people will dwell in Zion; and Jerusalem wept with weeping, "Have mercy on me." He will have mercy on you; when He saw the voice of your cry, He listened to you.
verses.30:20: And the Lord will give you bread of affliction and scant water, and no longer will those who lead you astray come near you; because your eyes will see those who lead you astray,
verses.30:21: and your ears will hear the words of those behind who led you astray, who say, "This is the way; let us walk in it, whether to the right or to the left."
verses.30:22: And you will defile the idols overlaid with silver and overlaid with gold; you will break them into fine pieces and scatter them like the water of a menstruating woman, and like dung you will push them away.
verses.30:23: Then the rain will be for the seed of your land, and the bread of the produce of your land will be plentiful and rich; and your livestock will graze in that day in a fertile and spacious place,
verses.30:24: your bulls and the oxen that work the ground will eat chaff mixed with winnowed barley.
verses.30:25: And upon every high mountain and upon every lofty hill there will be water flowing through in that day, when many perish, when towers fall.
verses.30:26: And the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be sevenfold, in the day when the Lord heals the fracture of His people, and He will heal the pain of your wound.
verses.30:27: Look, the name of the Lord comes after a long time, burning fury; with glory is the oracle of His lips, the oracle full of wrath, and the wrath of fury will devour like fire;
verses.30:28: and His breath, like water sweeping along in a ravine, will come up to the neck, and it will be divided to trouble nations in futile delusion, and delusion will pursue them and seize them before their face.
verses.30:29: Must you continually rejoice, and continually enter into My sanctuary as those keeping a festival, and as those rejoicing to enter with a flute into the mountain of the Lord, to the God of Israel?
verses.30:30: And the Lord will make the glory of His voice heard, and show the fury of His arm with fury and wrath and devouring flame, with a violent thunderblast, and like water and hail sweeping down together with violence.
verses.30:31: For through the voice of the Lord the Assyrians will be defeated, by the blow with which He strikes them.
verses.30:32: And it will happen to him from all around, from where their hope of help was, in which he had trusted; they themselves with tambourines and a lyre will fight against him in a reversal.
verses.30:33: For before days you will be called to account; was it also prepared for you to reign—a deep ravine, laid wood, fire and much wood? The fury of the Lord is like a ravine burning with sulfur.
verses.31:1: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, who trust in horses and in chariots, for they are many, and on horses there is an exceedingly great multitude; and they did not trust in the Holy One of Israel, and they did not seek the Lord.
verses.31:2: Yet He, being wise, brought evils upon them, and His word will certainly not be set aside, and He will rise up against houses of wicked people and against their futile hope,
verses.31:3: an Egyptian, a human being and not God, flesh of horses, and there is no help; and the Lord will bring His hand upon them, and those who help will grow weary, and all together they will perish.
verses.31:4: For thus the Lord said to me: "In the same way as the lion or the cub roars over the prey that it has caught, and cries out over it until the mountains are filled with its voice, and they are defeated, and the multitude of fury is terrified, so the Lord Sabaoth will come down to wage war upon Mount Zion, upon its mountains.
verses.31:5: Like flying birds, so the Lord Sabaoth will shield; He will shield Jerusalem and rescue it, and He will preserve and save it."
verses.31:6: Turn back, you who plan the deep and lawless plan, sons of Israel.
verses.31:7: For in that day people will renounce their silver handmade things and the gold handmade things, which their hands made.
verses.31:8: And Assyria will fall; not a sword of a man nor a sword of a human being will devour it, and it will flee not from the face of a sword; and the young men will be for defeat,
verses.31:9: for they will be surrounded by a rock as by a palisade and will be defeated, and the one who flees will be captured. Thus says the Lord: "Blessed is the one who has seed in Zion and relatives in Jerusalem."
verses.32:1: For look, a righteous king will reign, and rulers will rule with judgment.
verses.32:2: And the man will be hiding his words, and he will be hidden as from rushing water; and he will appear in Zion like a glorious rushing river in a thirsty land.
verses.32:3: And no longer will they be trusting in human beings, but they will give their ears to hear;
verses.32:4: and the heart of the weak will draw near to hear, and the stammering tongues will quickly learn to speak peace;
verses.32:5: and no longer will they tell the fool to rule, and no longer will your servants say, "Be silent!"
verses.32:6: For the fool will speak foolish things, and his heart will think futile things, to accomplish lawless deeds and to speak delusion against the Lord, to scatter hungry souls, and he will make thirsty souls empty.
verses.32:7: For the plan of the wicked will plan lawless things, to destroy the humble with unjust words and to disperse the words of the humble in judgment.
verses.32:8: But the godly planned prudent things, and this plan will remain.
verses.32:9: Wealthy women, arise and hear my voice; daughters in hope, listen to my words.
verses.32:10: Make remembrance for days of a year in pain with hope; the vintage is consumed; it has ceased; no longer will it come.
verses.32:11: Be dismayed, be grieved, you confident women; strip yourselves, become naked, gird your waists
verses.32:12: and beat upon your breasts, over a field of desire and a vine of produce.
verses.32:13: The land of my people—thorn and grass will come up, and from every house gladness will be taken away;
verses.32:14: wealthy city, abandoned houses will leave behind the wealth of a city, houses of desire; and the villages will become caves forever, a gladness of wild donkeys, pastures of shepherds,
verses.32:15: until a spirit comes upon you from on high. And Chermel will be a wilderness, and Chermel will be reckoned as a forest.
verses.32:16: And justice will rest in the wilderness, and righteousness will dwell in Carmel;
verses.32:17: and the works of righteousness will be peace, and righteousness will hold fast to rest, and they will be confident forever;
verses.32:18: and His people will dwell in a city of peace and will reside in confidence, and they will rest with wealth.
verses.32:19: And if the hail comes down, it will not come upon you. And those who reside in the forests will be confident, as in the plain.
verses.32:20: Blessed are those who sow beside every water, where ox and donkey tread.
verses.33:1: Woe to those who bring misery upon you, yet no one makes you miserable; and the one who breaks faith with you does not break faith; those who break faith will be captured and handed over, and like a moth on a garment, so they will be defeated.
verses.33:2: Lord, have mercy on us, for in You we have trusted; the seed of the disobedient has come to destruction, but our salvation is in a time of distress.
verses.33:3: Because of the sound of fear, peoples were dismayed at the fear of You, and the nations were scattered.
verses.33:4: But now your spoils will be gathered, of small and great; just as when someone gathers locusts, so they will mock you.
verses.33:5: Holy is God, who dwells on high; Zion has been filled with justice; and in righteousness
verses.33:6: by law they will be handed over; in treasures is our salvation; there has come wisdom and knowledge and godliness toward the Lord; these are treasures of righteousness.
verses.33:7: Look now, in your fear these will be afraid; those whom you used to fear will cry out because of you; messengers will be sent, weeping bitterly, pleading for peace.
verses.33:8: For the ways of these will be made desolate; the fear of the nations has ceased, and the covenant with these is taken away, and you will by no means consider them human beings.
verses.33:9: The land mourned, Lebanon was put to shame, Sharon became marshes; Galilee and Carmel will be exposed.
verses.33:10: "Now I will arise," says the Lord, "now I will be glorified, now I will be exalted;
verses.33:11: now you will see, now you will perceive; futile will be the strength of your spirit, fire will devour you,
verses.33:12: and nations will be burned up like a thornbush cast out in a field and burned up.
verses.33:13: Those who are far off will hear what I have done; those who draw near will know My strength."
verses.33:14: The lawless in Zion have departed; trembling will seize the ungodly. Who will announce to you that fire is burning? Who will announce to you the eternal place?
verses.33:15: One who walks in righteousness, speaking a straight way, hating lawlessness and unrighteousness, and shaking his hands away from gifts, dulling his ears so that he may not hear a judgment of blood, shutting his eyes so that he may not see unrighteousness,
verses.33:16: this one will dwell in a high cave of a strong rock; bread will be given to him, and his water is sure.
verses.33:17: You will see a king with glory; your eyes will see a land from afar.
verses.33:18: Our soul will meditate on fear. Where are the scribes? Where are the counselors? Where is the one who counts those being nourished,
verses.33:19: a small and great people? One with whom he did not take counsel, nor did he know a deep-voiced one, so that a despised people did not hear, and there is no understanding for the one who hears.
verses.33:20: Look, Zion the city, our salvation; your eyes will see Jerusalem, a rich city, tents that will by no means be shaken, nor will the stakes of its tent be moved for eternal time, nor will its ropes ever be broken.
verses.33:21: For the name of the Lord is great for you. There will be a place for you, rivers and canals wide and spacious; you will not go this way, nor will a rowing ship go on it.
verses.33:22: For my God is great; He will not pass me by; the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our ruler, the Lord is our king, the Lord, He will save us.
verses.33:23: Your ropes were broken, because they were not strong; your mast tilted; it will not slacken the sails, it will not raise a standard, until it is handed over for plunder; therefore many lame people will take plunder.
verses.33:24: And the people dwelling among them will by no means say, "I am weary," for their sin has been forgiven.
verses.34:1: Draw near, nations, and hear, rulers; let the earth hear and those who are in it, the inhabited world and the people who are in it.
verses.34:2: For the wrath of the Lord is against all the nations, and anger against their number, to destroy them and to hand them over to slaughter.
verses.34:3: And their wounded will be cast out, and the dead, and their stench will go up, and the mountains will be drenched with their blood.
verses.34:4: And all the powers of the heavens will melt, and heaven will be rolled up like a scroll, and all the stars will fall like leaves from a vine, and as leaves fall from a fig tree.
verses.34:5: My sword has become drunk in heaven; look, it will come down upon Idumea and upon the people of destruction with judgment.
verses.34:6: The sword of the Lord has been filled with blood; it has been fattened from fat, from the blood of male goats and lambs, and from the fat of male goats and rams. For there is a sacrifice to the Lord in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in Idumea,
verses.34:7: and the mighty ones will fall with them, and the rams and the bulls; and the land will become drunk from the blood, and from their fat it will be filled.
verses.34:8: For it is a day of the Lord's judgment, and a year of recompense for the judgment of Zion.
verses.34:9: And its ravines will be turned into pitch, and its land into sulfur; and its land will be like burning pitch
verses.34:10: night and day, and it will not be quenched for eternal time, and its smoke will rise upward; for its generations it will be made desolate, and for a long time.
verses.34:11: Birds and hedgehogs and ibises and ravens will dwell in it; and a cord of desert surveying will be cast upon it, and onocentaurs will live in it.
verses.34:12: Its rulers will be no more; for its kings and its nobles will come to destruction.
verses.34:13: And thorny trees will spring up in their cities and in its strongholds, and it will be dwellings of sirens and a court of ostriches.
verses.34:14: And demons will meet with onocentaurs, and they will cry out one to another; there onocentaurs will rest, having found rest for themselves.
verses.34:15: There a hedgehog made its nest, and the land saved its young in safety; there deer met and saw one another's faces.
verses.34:16: They passed by in number, and not one of them perished; one did not seek another, because the Lord commanded them, and His Spirit gathered them.
verses.34:17: And He Himself will cast lots for them, and His hand apportioned it for grazing; for eternal time you will inherit it; for generations of generations they will rest upon it.
verses.35:1: Be glad, thirsty desert; let the desert exult and blossom like a lily,
verses.35:2: and the desert places of the Jordan will blossom forth and exult; the glory of Lebanon has been given to it, and the honor of Carmel, and My people will see the glory of the Lord and the majesty of God.
verses.35:3: Be strong, drooping hands and paralyzed knees.
verses.35:4: Take comfort, you who are fainthearted in mind; be strong, do not fear; look, our God renders judgment and will render it; He Himself will come and save us.
verses.35:5: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will hear.
verses.35:6: Then the lame one will leap like a deer, and the tongue of those who speak with difficulty will be clear, because water has broken forth in the desert, and a ravine in a thirsty land,
verses.35:7: and the waterless land will become marshes, and in the thirsty land there will be a spring of water; there will be gladness of birds, dwellings of reeds and marshes.
verses.35:8: There will be a clean way there, and it will be called a holy way, and an unclean person will by no means pass there, nor will there be an unclean way there; but the scattered ones will walk upon it; they will by no means go astray.
verses.35:9: And no lion will be there, nor will any of the evil beasts go up onto it, nor ever be found there, but the redeemed will walk on it,
verses.35:10: and those gathered because of the Lord; and they will return and come to Zion with gladness, and eternal gladness will be over their head, praise and exultation, and gladness will overtake them; pain and sorrow and groaning have fled away.
verses.36:1: And it happened in the fourteenth year, while Hezekiah was reigning, that Sennacherib, king of the Assyrians, went up against the fortified cities of Judea and took them.
verses.36:2: And the king of the Assyrians sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a great army; and he stood at the aqueduct of the upper pool, on the road of the fuller's field.
verses.36:3: And Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, the steward, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder, went out to him.
verses.36:4: And Rabshakeh said to them, "Say to Hezekiah, 'Thus says the great king, the king of the Assyrians: What are you trusting in?
verses.36:5: Does battle array come about through counsel and words of the lips? And now, in whom are you trusting, that you disobey me?
verses.36:6: Look, you are trusting in this crushed reed staff, in Egypt; whoever leans on it, it will enter into his hand. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt, and all who trust in him.'
verses.36:7: And if you say, 'We trust in the Lord our God,'
verses.36:8: now join with my master, the king of the Assyrians, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you will be able to put riders on them.
verses.36:9: And how can you turn back in the face of the governors? Those who trust in Egypt are household servants, for horse and rider.
verses.36:10: And now, did we come up against this country without the Lord to fight against it? The Lord said to me, 'Go up against this land and destroy it.'"
verses.36:11: And Eliakim and Shebna and Joah said to him, "Speak to your servants in Syrian, for we understand, and do not speak to us in Judean; and why are you speaking in the ears of the people on the wall?"
verses.36:12: And Rabshakeh said to them, "Has my master sent me to your master or to you to speak these words? Was it not to the people sitting on the wall, so that they may eat dung and drink urine together with you?"
verses.36:13: And Rabshakeh stood and cried out with a loud voice in Judean and said, "Hear the words of the great king, the king of the Assyrians.
verses.36:14: Thus says the king: 'Do not let Hezekiah deceive you with words; he will by no means be able to deliver you.
verses.36:15: And do not let Hezekiah say to you, "God will deliver you, and this city will by no means be handed over into the hand of the king of the Assyrians."'
verses.36:16: Do not listen to Hezekiah. Thus says the king of the Assyrians: 'If you wish to be blessed, come out to me, and each of you will eat his vine and the fig trees, and you will drink water from your bronze vessel,
verses.36:17: until I come and take you to a land like your land, a land of grain and wine and bread and vineyards.
verses.36:18: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, saying, "God will deliver you." Did the gods of the nations each deliver his own country from the hand of the king of the Assyrians?
verses.36:19: Where is the god of Hamath and Arpad? And where is the god of the city of Epharvaim? Were they able to deliver Samaria from my hand?
verses.36:20: Who among all the gods of these nations is there who delivered his land from my hand, that God will deliver Jerusalem from my hand?'"
verses.36:21: And they were silent, and no one answered him a word, because the king had commanded no one to answer.
verses.36:22: And Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, the steward, and Shebna the scribe of the army, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder, came in to Hezekiah with their tunics torn, and reported to him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.37:1: And it happened, when King Hezekiah heard, that he tore his garments and wrapped himself in sackcloth, and went up into the house of the Lord.
verses.37:2: And he sent Eliakim the steward and Shebna the scribe and the elders of the priests, wrapped in sackcloth, to Isaiah the son of Amoz, the prophet;
verses.37:3: and they said to him, "Thus says Hezekiah: 'This day is a day of distress and reproach and rebuke and wrath; for labor pain has come to the woman giving birth, yet she has no strength to give birth.
verses.37:4: May the Lord your God listen to the words of Rabshakeh, which the king of the Assyrians sent to reproach the living God and to reproach with words that the Lord your God has heard; and pray to your Lord concerning these who are left.'"
verses.37:5: And the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah,
verses.37:6: and Isaiah said to them, "Thus you shall say to your master, 'Thus says the Lord: Do not be afraid of the words that you heard, with which the envoys of the king of the Assyrians reproached Me.
verses.37:7: Look, I am putting a spirit in him, and when he hears a report he will turn back to his own country, and he will fall by the sword in his own land.'"
verses.37:8: And Rabshakeh turned back and found the king of the Assyrians besieging Libnah, and he heard that he had departed from Lachish.
verses.37:9: And Tirhakah, king of the Ethiopians, went out to besiege him; and when he heard, he turned back and sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.37:10: "Thus you shall say to Hezekiah, king of Judea, 'Do not let your God, in whom you trust, deceive you, saying, "Jerusalem will by no means be handed over into the hand of the king of the Assyrians."
verses.37:11: Have you not heard what the kings of the Assyrians did to all the earth, how they destroyed it? And will you be delivered?
verses.37:12: Did the gods of the nations whom my fathers destroyed deliver them—both Gozan and Haran and Rapheth, which are in the country of Theemath?
verses.37:13: Where are the kings of Hamath, and where are those of Arpad? And where are those of the city of Epharvaim, Anag, Ugava?'"
verses.37:14: And Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers and read it, and he went up into the house of the Lord and opened it before the Lord.
verses.37:15: And Hezekiah prayed to the Lord, saying,
verses.37:16: "Lord Sabaoth, the God of Israel, who sits upon the cherubim, You alone are God of every kingdom of the world; You made heaven and earth.
verses.37:17: Incline Your ear, Lord; listen, Lord! Open Your eyes, Lord; look, Lord, and see the words of Sennacherib that he sent to reproach the living God.
verses.37:18: For truly the kings of the Assyrians have laid waste the whole world and their country,
verses.37:19: and threw their idols into the fire—for they were not gods, but works of human hands, wood and stones—and cast them away.
verses.37:20: But now, Lord our God, save us from his hand, so that every kingdom of the earth may know that You alone are God."
verses.37:21: And Isaiah the son of Amoz was sent to Hezekiah and said to him, "Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: 'I have heard what you prayed to Me concerning Sennacherib, king of the Assyrians.'"
verses.37:22: This is the word that God spoke concerning him: "The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and mocked you; the daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.
verses.37:23: Whom have you reproached and provoked? Or against whom have you raised your voice? And did you not lift up your eyes on high toward the Holy One of Israel?
verses.37:24: Because through messengers you reproached the Lord; for you said, 'With the multitude of chariots I went up to the height of mountains and to the farthest parts of Lebanon, and I cut down the height of its cedar and the beauty of the cypress, and I entered into the height of part of the forest,
verses.37:25: and I set a bridge, and I laid waste waters and every gathering of water.'
verses.37:26: Did I not hear long ago what I did? From ancient days I ordained it, and now I have shown it—to utterly lay waste nations in strongholds and those dwelling in fortified cities;
verses.37:27: I slackened the hands, and they dried up, and became like dry grass on rooftops and like couch grass.
verses.37:28: But now I know your resting and your going out and your coming in;
verses.37:29: and your rage with which you raged and your bitterness has come up to Me, and I will put a muzzle in your nose and a bridle on your lips, and I will turn you back by the way on which you came.
verses.37:30: And this will be the sign for you: eat this year what you have sown, and in the second year what is left, and in the third year sow and reap, and plant vineyards, and you will eat their fruit.
verses.37:31: And those who are left will be in Judea; they will put forth root downward and produce seed upward.
verses.37:32: For out of Jerusalem will be those who are left, and those who are saved out of Mount Zion; the zeal of the Lord Sabaoth will do these things."
verses.37:33: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the king of the Assyrians: "He will by no means enter this city, nor shoot an arrow against it, nor bring a shield against it, nor surround it with a palisade;
verses.37:34: but by the way on which he came, by it he will turn back, and into this city he will by no means enter," thus says the Lord.
verses.37:35: "I will shield this city to save it, for My own sake and for the sake of David My servant."
verses.37:36: And the angel of the Lord went out and killed one hundred eighty-five thousand from the camp of the Assyrians; and when they rose in the morning, they found all the bodies dead.
verses.37:37: And Sennacherib, king of the Assyrians, turned back and departed, and lived in Nineveh.
verses.37:38: And while he was worshiping his ancestral god in the house of Nisroch, Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him down with swords, and they escaped safely to Armenia; and Esarhaddon his son reigned in his place.
verses.38:1: Now it happened at that time that Hezekiah became ill to the point of death; and Isaiah son of Amoz, the prophet, came to him and said to him, "Thus says the Lord: 'Give orders concerning your house, for you are dying and you will not live.'"
verses.38:2: And Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall and prayed to the Lord,
verses.38:3: saying, "Remember, Lord, how I walked before You with truth, in a true heart, and did what is pleasing before You." And Hezekiah wept with great weeping.
verses.38:4: And the word of the Lord came to Isaiah, saying,
verses.38:5: "Go and say to Hezekiah, 'Thus says the Lord, the God of David your father: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears; look, I am adding fifteen years to your time,
verses.38:6: and from the hand of the king of the Assyrians I will rescue you and this city, and I will shield this city.
verses.38:7: And this is the sign to you from the Lord that God will do this thing:
verses.38:8: Look, I am turning the shadow of the steps that the sun went down, the ten steps of the house of your father—I will turn back the sun the ten steps.'" And the sun went up the ten steps that the shadow had gone down.
verses.38:9: A prayer of Hezekiah, king of Judea, when he became ill and recovered from his illness.
verses.38:10: I said, "In the height of my days, in the gates of Hades, I will leave behind the remaining years."
verses.38:11: I said, "No longer will I see the salvation of God in the land of the living; no longer will I see the salvation of Israel on the earth; no longer will I see a human being."
verses.38:12: It failed from my kindred; I left behind the remainder of my life; it went out and went away from me like one taking down a tent after pitching it. My spirit within me became like the web of a weaver drawing near to cut it off.
verses.38:13: In that day I was handed over until morning as to a lion; it crushed all my bones, for from the day until night I was handed over.
verses.38:14: Like a swallow, so I will cry out, and like a dove, so I moan; for my eyes failed from looking to the height of heaven, to the Lord, who rescued me
verses.38:15: and took away the pain of my soul.
verses.38:16: Lord, for concerning it, it was declared to You, and You raised up my breath, and having been comforted, I lived.
verses.38:17: For You chose my soul so that it would not perish, and You cast behind me all the sins.
verses.38:18: For those in Hades will not praise You, nor will those who have died bless You, nor will those in Hades hope for Your mercy.
verses.38:19: The living will bless You, just as I also do; for from today I will produce children, who will declare Your righteousness,
verses.38:20: God of my salvation; and I will not cease blessing You with a harp all the days of my life before the house of God.
verses.38:21: And Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Take a cake of figs and crush it and apply it as a poultice, and you will be well."
verses.38:22: And Hezekiah said, "This is a sign to Hezekiah that I will go up to the house of God."
verses.39:1: At that time Merodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, the king of Babylonia, sent letters and envoys and gifts; for he heard that he had become ill to the point of death and had recovered.
verses.39:2: And Hezekiah rejoiced over them, and he showed them the house of nechotha, and of silver, and of gold, and of stacte, and of incense, and of perfumed oil, and all the houses of the vessels of the treasure, and everything that was in his treasuries; and there was nothing that Hezekiah did not show in his house.
verses.39:3: And Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah and said to him, "What do these men say, and from where have they come to you?" And Hezekiah said, "From a land far away they have come to me, from Babylon."
verses.39:4: And Isaiah said, "What did they see in your house?" And Hezekiah said, "All the things in my house they saw, and there is nothing in my house that they did not see, but also the things in my treasuries."
verses.39:5: And Isaiah said to him, "Hear the word of the Lord Sabaoth:
verses.39:6: Look, days are coming, and they will take everything that is in your house, and all that your fathers gathered until this day will come to Babylon, and they will certainly leave nothing behind; and God said,
verses.39:7: 'Even from your children whom you will father they will take, and they will make them eunuchs in the house of the king of the Babylonians.'"
verses.39:8: And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "Good is the word of the Lord that He spoke; let there indeed be peace and righteousness in my days."
verses.40:2: Priests, speak to the heart of Jerusalem, comfort her, because her humiliation has been fulfilled; her sin has been pardoned, because she received from the hand of the Lord double for her sins.
verses.40:3: A voice of one crying out in the wilderness: "Prepare the way of the Lord; make the paths of our God straight."
verses.40:4: Every valley will be filled, and every mountain and hill will be brought low; and all the crooked places will become straight, and the rough ground into plains,
verses.40:5: and the glory of the Lord will be seen, and all flesh will see the salvation of God, for the Lord has spoken.
verses.40:6: A voice of one saying, "Cry out." And I said, "What should I cry out?" "All flesh is grass, and all the glory of humanity is like a flower of grass.
verses.40:7: The grass has dried up, and the flower has fallen off,
verses.40:8: but the word of our God remains forever."
verses.40:9: Go up onto a high mountain, you who bring good news to Zion; lift up your voice with strength, you who bring good news to Jerusalem; lift it up, do not be afraid; say to the cities of Judah, "Look, your God!"
verses.40:10: Look, the Lord, the Lord comes with strength, and the arm with authority; look, His reward is with Him, and the work before Him.
verses.40:11: Like a shepherd He will shepherd His flock, and with His arm He will gather lambs, and those with young He will comfort.
verses.40:12: Who measured the water with the hand, and heaven with a span, and all the earth with a handful? Who weighed the mountains on a scale and the wooded valleys on a balance?
verses.40:13: Who has known the mind of the Lord, and who became His counselor, who will instruct Him?
verses.40:14: Or with whom did He take counsel, and who instructed Him? Or who showed Him justice? Or who showed Him the way of understanding?
verses.40:15: If all the nations were counted as a drop from a bucket and as a tilt of a balance, they will be counted as spittle;
verses.40:16: and Lebanon is not sufficient for burning, and all the four-footed animals are not sufficient for a whole burnt offering,
verses.40:17: and all the nations are as nothing and were counted for nothing.
verses.40:18: To whom have you likened the Lord, and to what likeness have you likened Him?
verses.40:19: Did a craftsman make an image, or did a goldsmith melt gold and overlay it with gold? Did he construct it as a likeness?
verses.40:20: For a craftsman chooses unrotting wood, and skillfully seeks how he will set up his image and that it may not be shaken.
verses.40:21: Will you not know? Will you not hear? Was it not declared to you from the beginning? Did you not know the foundations of the earth?
verses.40:22: He who holds the circle of the earth, and those who dwell in it are like locusts; He who set up heaven like a vault and stretched it out like a tent to dwell in,
verses.40:23: He who gives rulers to rule as nothing, and made the earth as nothing.
verses.40:24: For they will by no means plant, nor will they sow, nor will their root be rooted in the earth; He blew upon them and they dried up, and a storm will take them like brushwood.
verses.40:25: "Now therefore, to whom have you likened Me, and I will be exalted?" said the Holy One.
verses.40:26: Lift up your eyes to the height and see: who displayed all these things? He who brings out His array by number will call them all by name from great glory, and in the might of strength nothing escaped your notice.
verses.40:27: For do not say, Jacob, and why did you speak, Israel, "My way has been hidden from God, and my God has taken away justice and departed"?
verses.40:28: And now, have you not known? Have you not heard? An eternal God, the God who constructed the ends of the earth, will not hunger nor grow weary, nor is there any finding out of His understanding,
verses.40:29: giving strength to those who hunger, and sorrow to those who are not suffering pain.
verses.40:30: For youths will grow hungry, and young men will grow weary, and chosen ones will be without strength;
verses.40:31: but those who wait for God will renew strength; they will grow wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary; they will walk and not grow hungry.
verses.41:1: Renew yourselves toward Me, islands, for the rulers will renew strength; let them draw near and speak together, then let them declare judgment.
verses.41:2: Who raised up righteousness from the east, called it at His feet, and it will go? He will give it before nations, and He will dismay kings; and He will give their swords to the earth, and their bows like driven brushwood;
verses.41:3: and He will pursue them; the way of His feet will pass through in peace.
verses.41:4: Who worked and did these things? He who calls it from the generations of the beginning called it: I, God, am first, and for the things to come, I am.
verses.41:5: Nations saw and feared; the ends of the earth drew near and came together,
verses.41:6: each deciding to help his neighbor and his brother, and he will say,
verses.41:7: "A craftsman has grown strong, and a smith striking with a hammer, beating at the same time." Sometimes he will say, "The joint is good"; he made them firm with nails; they will set them up, and they will not be moved.
verses.41:8: But you, Israel, My servant Jacob whom I chose, seed of Abraham whom I loved,
verses.41:9: whom I took hold of from the ends of the earth, and from its watchtowers I called you and said to you, "You are My servant; I chose you and did not forsake you."
verses.41:10: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be led astray, for I am your God who strengthened you, and I helped you and made you secure with My righteous right hand.
verses.41:11: Look, all who oppose you will be ashamed and disgraced, for they will be as those who do not exist, and all your adversaries will perish.
verses.41:12: You will seek them, and you will by no means find the people who will act abusively toward you; for they will be as those who do not exist, and those who wage war against you will not exist.
verses.41:13: For I am your God, who grasps your right hand, who says to you,
verses.41:14: "Do not fear, Jacob, tiny Israel; I helped you," says God, who redeems Israel.
verses.41:15: Look, I have made you like new, saw-toothed threshing wheels of a cart, and you will thresh mountains and grind hills fine, and make them like chaff,
verses.41:16: and you will winnow; and a wind will take them, and a whirlwind will scatter them. But you will rejoice in the holy ones of Israel,
verses.41:17: and the poor and the needy will exult. For they will seek water and there will be none; their tongue has dried up from thirst. I am the Lord God; I, the God of Israel, will hear and will not forsake them,
verses.41:18: rather, I will open rivers upon the mountains and springs in the midst of plains; I will make the wilderness into marshes of water and the thirsty land in water channels;
verses.41:19: I will place in the waterless land cedar and box tree, myrtle and cypress and white poplar,
verses.41:20: so that they may see and know and consider and understand together that the hand of the Lord did these things, and the Holy One of Israel revealed them.
verses.41:21: "Your judgment draws near," says the Lord God; "your counsels have drawn near," says the King of Jacob.
verses.41:22: Let them draw near and declare to you what will happen, or tell what the former things were, and we will apply our mind, and we will know what the last things are, and tell us the things to come.
verses.41:23: Declare to us the things to come at the end, and we will know that you are gods. Do good and do harm, and we will marvel, and we will see together;
verses.41:24: for where are you from, and where is your work from? From the earth! They chose you an abomination.
verses.41:25: But I raised up the one from the north and the one from the rising of the sun; they will be called by My name. Let rulers come, and like potter's clay and like a potter trampling the clay, so you will be trampled.
verses.41:26: For who will declare the things from the beginning, so that we may know, and the things beforehand, and we will say that they are true? There is no one who foretells, nor anyone who hears your words.
verses.41:27: I will give a beginning to Zion, and I will comfort Jerusalem.
verses.41:28: For from the nations, look, there is no one, and from their idols there was no one declaring; and if I ask them, "Where are you from?" they will by no means answer Me.
verses.41:29: For there are those who make you, and in vain are those who lead you astray.
verses.42:1: Jacob is My servant; I will take hold of him; Israel is My chosen one; My soul has accepted him. I have put My Spirit upon him; he will bring forth judgment to the nations.
verses.42:2: He will not cry out nor let up, nor will his voice be heard outside.
verses.42:3: A bruised reed he will not shatter, and smoldering flax he will not extinguish; rather, he will bring forth judgment for truth.
verses.42:4: He will shine out and will not be broken until he establishes judgment on the earth; and in his name nations will hope.
verses.42:5: Thus says the Lord God, who made the heaven and fixed it, who established the earth and the things in it, and who gives breath to the people on it and spirit to those who tread on it:
verses.42:6: "I, the Lord God, called you in righteousness, and I will grasp your hand and strengthen you, and I gave you for a covenant of a race,
verses.42:7: to open the eyes of the blind, to bring out from bonds those who are bound, and from a prison house those sitting in darkness.
verses.42:8: I am the Lord God; this is My name; My glory I will not give to another, nor My excellences to carved images.
verses.42:9: The things from the beginning, look, have come, and new things are what I declare; and before declaring them, they were made known to you."
verses.42:10: Sing a new hymn to the Lord; its beginning: glorify His name from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea and sail it, the islands and those who inhabit them.
verses.42:11: Rejoice, wilderness and its villages, encampments and those who inhabit Kedar. Those who inhabit the rock will rejoice; from the top of the mountains they will shout;
verses.42:12: they will give glory to God; His excellences they will declare in the islands.
verses.42:13: The Lord God of powers will go forth and shatter war; He will stir up zeal and shout against His enemies with strength.
verses.42:14: I kept silent; will I even keep silent forever and hold back? Like the woman giving birth, I endured; I will dismay and dry up at once.
verses.42:15: I will lay waste mountains and hills, and all their grass I will dry up; and I will turn rivers into islands, and I will dry up marshes.
verses.42:16: And I will lead the blind in a way that they did not know, and paths that they had not known I will make them tread; I will make the darkness into light for them, and the crooked things straight. These things I will do, and I will not forsake them;
verses.42:17: but they themselves turned back. Be ashamed with shame, you who trust in carved images, who say to cast images, "You are our gods."
verses.42:18: You deaf, hear, and you blind, look up to see!
verses.42:19: And who is blind except My servants, and deaf except those who rule over them? And the servants of God were blinded.
verses.42:20: You saw many times, and did not take heed; your ears were open, and you did not hear.
verses.42:21: The Lord God purposed that He might be justified and magnify praise.
verses.42:22: And I saw, and the people became plundered and pillaged; for the snare is in the inner rooms everywhere, and in houses alike, where they hid them, they became plunder; and there was no one rescuing the spoil, and there was no one saying, "Give back!"
verses.42:23: Who among you will give ear to these things? Listen to the things to come
verses.42:24: upon those to whom He gave Jacob and Israel for pillaging, to those who plundered him. Was it not God, against whom they sinned, and they were not willing to walk in His ways nor to listen to His law?
verses.42:25: And He brought upon them the wrath of His fury, and war overpowered them, and those burning them up all around; and not one of them knew, nor did they lay it upon their soul.
verses.43:1: And now thus says the Lord God, who made you, Jacob, and who formed you, Israel: "Do not be afraid, because I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine.
verses.43:2: And if you cross through water, I am with you, and rivers will not flood over you; and if you pass through fire, you will by no means be burned up; flame will not burn you up.
verses.43:3: For I am the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, who saves you; I have made Egypt and Ethiopia an exchange for you, and Syene in your place.
verses.43:4: Since you became precious in My sight, you have been glorified, and I have loved you; and I will give people for you and rulers for your head.
verses.43:5: Do not be afraid, because I am with you; from the east I will bring your seed, and from the west I will gather you.
verses.43:6: I will say to the north, 'Bring them,' and to the southwest, 'Do not hold back; bring My sons from a land far away, and My daughters from the ends of the earth,
verses.43:7: all who have been called by My name.' For in My glory I fashioned him and formed him and made him,
verses.43:8: and I brought out a blind people, and eyes are likewise blind, and deaf ones who have ears.
verses.43:9: All the nations have been gathered together, and rulers from among them will be gathered. Who will declare these things? Or who will declare to you the things from the beginning? Let them bring their witnesses and be justified, and let them hear, and let them speak true things.
verses.43:10: Become witnesses for Me, and I am a witness," says the Lord God, "and the servant whom I have chosen, so that you may know and believe and understand that I am; before Me no other god came to be, and after Me there will be none.
verses.43:11: I am God, and apart from Me there is no one who saves.
verses.43:12: I declared and I saved; I reproached, and there was no stranger among us; you are witnesses for Me, and I am the Lord God
verses.43:13: even from the beginning, and there is no one who rescues out of My hands; I will act, and who will turn it back?"
verses.43:14: Thus says the Lord God who redeems you, the Holy One of Israel: "For your sake I will send to Babylon and will stir up all who flee, and the Chaldeans will be bound in ships.
verses.43:15: I am the Lord God, your Holy One, who appointed Israel as your king."
verses.43:16: Thus says the Lord, who gives a way in the sea and a path in mighty water,
verses.43:17: who brought out chariots and horse and a mighty crowd—but they will lie down and will not rise; they were quenched like quenched flax:
verses.43:18: "Do not remember the former things, and do not ponder the ancient things.
verses.43:19: Look, I am doing new things that will now spring up, and you will know them. And I will make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the waterless land.
verses.43:20: The wild beasts of the field will bless Me, sirens and daughters of ostriches, because I gave water in the wilderness and rivers in the waterless land, to give drink to My chosen race,
verses.43:21: My people whom I acquired for Myself to recount My excellences.
verses.43:22: It was not now that I called you, Jacob, nor did I make you grow weary, Israel;
verses.43:23: your sheep of your whole burnt offering are not for Me, nor did you glorify Me in your sacrifices, nor did I make you weary with frankincense,
verses.43:24: nor did you buy an offering for Me with silver, nor did I desire the fat of your sacrifices; instead, in your sins you stood before Me, and in your unrighteous deeds.
verses.43:25: I am, I am the One who blots out your lawless deeds for My sake, and your sins, and I will not remember them.
verses.43:26: But you, remember, and let us enter into judgment; you state your lawless deeds first, so that you may be justified.
verses.43:27: Your fathers first and your rulers acted lawlessly against Me,
verses.43:28: and the rulers defiled My holy things; and I gave Jacob over to be destroyed, and Israel to reproach."
verses.44:1: "But now listen, Jacob My servant, and Israel whom I have chosen,"
verses.44:2: thus says the Lord God who made you and who formed you from the womb: "You will yet be helped; do not be afraid, My servant Jacob, and beloved Israel whom I have chosen.
verses.44:3: For I will give water in thirst to those who walk in a waterless land; I will put My Spirit upon your seed, and My blessings upon your children,
verses.44:4: and they will spring up like grass in the midst of water, and like a willow by flowing water.
verses.44:5: This one will say, 'I belong to God,' and this one will cry out by the name of Jacob, and another will write with his hand, 'I belong to God,' and by the name of Israel he will cry out."
verses.44:6: Thus says the King of Israel and the One who rescued him, God Sabaoth: "I am first, and I am after these things; besides Me there is no God.
verses.44:7: Who is like Me? Let him stand and call out and declare, and let him prepare for Me from the time I made humanity forever, and let them declare to you the things that are coming before they arrive.
verses.44:8: Do not hide yourselves and do not be led astray; did you not give ear from the beginning, and I declared it to you? You are witnesses: is there a God besides Me?"
verses.44:9: And they did not listen then. Those who form and those who carve are all futile, making their cherished things, which will not profit them; instead, they will be put to shame.
verses.44:10: Those who form a god and carve one are all unprofitable,
verses.44:11: and all from whom they came have dried up, and they are deaf from among people; let them all be gathered and stand together, and let them be disgraced and put to shame together.
verses.44:12: Because a craftsman sharpened iron, with an adze he worked it and with a drill he set it, and he worked it with the arm of his strength; and he will grow hungry and grow weak and will by no means drink water.
verses.44:13: Having chosen wood, a craftsman set it by measure, and shaped it with glue, and made it like the form of a man and like the beauty of a human being, to set it up in a house.
verses.44:14: He cut down wood from the forest which the Lord planted, and rain made it grow tall,
verses.44:15: so that it might be for burning for people; and taking from it, he warmed himself, and burning them, they baked loaves upon them; but the rest they worked into gods, and they bow down to them.
verses.44:16: Half of which he burned up in fire, and upon half of it he baked loaves on the coals, and roasting meat upon it, he ate and was filled, and having warmed himself, he said, "How pleasant for me, because I have warmed myself and seen a fire!"
verses.44:17: And the rest he made into a carved god, and he bows down and prays to it, saying, "Rescue me, because you are my god."
verses.44:18: They did not know how to understand, because they were darkened from seeing with their eyes and from perceiving with their heart.
verses.44:19: And he did not consider in his soul, nor did he recognize in his understanding that half of it he burned up in fire, and baked loaves on its coals, and having roasted meat, ate it, and the rest of it he made into an abomination, and they bow down to it.
verses.44:20: Know that their heart is ashes, and they are led astray, and no one is able to rescue his soul; look, you will not say, "There is a lie in my right hand."
verses.44:21: "Remember these things, Jacob and Israel, because you are My servant; I formed you as My servant, and you, Israel, do not forget Me.
verses.44:22: For look, I have wiped away your lawless deeds like a cloud, and your sins like a dark cloud; turn back to Me, and I will redeem you."
verses.44:23: Be glad, heavens, because God has had mercy on Israel; sound the trumpet, foundations of the earth; cry out with gladness, mountains, the hills and all the trees that are in them, because God has redeemed Jacob, and Israel will be glorified.
verses.44:24: Thus says the Lord who redeems you and forms you from the womb: "I am the Lord who accomplishes all things; I stretched out heaven alone, and I made the earth firm.
verses.44:25: Who else will scatter the signs of ventriloquists and divinations from the heart, turning wise men backward and making their counsel foolish,
verses.44:26: and establishing the words of His servant, and proving the counsel of His messengers true? The One who says to Jerusalem, 'You will be inhabited,' and to the cities of Idumea, 'You will be built,' and its deserted places will spring up;
verses.44:27: the One who says to the abyss, 'You will be made desolate, and I will dry up your rivers';
verses.44:28: the One who tells Cyrus to be wise, and, 'He will do all My wishes'; the One who says to Jerusalem, 'You will be built, and I will lay the foundation of My holy house.'"
verses.45:1: Thus says the Lord God to My anointed Cyrus, whose right hand I took hold of so that nations may obey before him, and I will break apart the strength of kings; I will open doors before him, and cities will not be shut:
verses.45:2: "I will go before you and level mountains; I will shatter bronze doors and break apart iron bars,
verses.45:3: and I will give you dark, hidden treasures; I will open unseen ones to you, so that you may know that I am the Lord God, who calls your name, the God of Israel.
verses.45:4: For the sake of My servant Jacob and Israel, My chosen one, I will call you by My name and I will accept you; yet you did not know Me.
verses.45:5: For I am the Lord God, and there is no other besides Me; I strengthened you, and you did not know Me,
verses.45:6: so that those from the rising of the sun and those from the west may know that there is none besides Me. I am the Lord God, and there is no other,
verses.45:7: I am the One who fashioned light and made darkness, who makes peace and creates evils; I am the Lord God, who does all these things.
verses.45:8: Let heaven above rejoice, and let the clouds sprinkle righteousness; let the earth spring up and sprout mercy, and let it declare righteousness at the same time; I am the Lord, who created you.
verses.45:9: What better thing have I fashioned like potter's clay? Will the one who plows plow the ground all day long? Will the clay say to the potter, 'What are you making, for you do not work, nor do you have hands?' Will the thing formed answer the one who formed it?
verses.45:10: The one who says to a father, 'What will you beget?' and to a mother, 'What are you in labor with?'"
verses.45:11: For thus says the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel, who made the things that are coming: "Ask Me about My sons, and concerning the works of My hands, command Me.
verses.45:12: I made the earth and man upon it; I, with My hand, made heaven firm; I commanded all the stars.
verses.45:13: I raised him up as king with righteousness, and all his ways are straight; this one will build My city, and he will bring back the captivity of My people, not with ransom nor with gifts," said the Lord Sabaoth.
verses.45:14: Thus says the Lord Sabaoth: "Egypt has labored, and the merchandise of the Ethiopians, and the Sabeans, tall men, will cross over to you, and they will be servants to you, and they will follow behind you bound in manacles; and they will cross over to you and bow down to you, and in you they will pray: 'God is in you, and there is no God besides You.
verses.45:15: For You are God, and we did not know, the God of Israel.'
verses.45:16: All who oppose Him will be put to shame and humiliated, and they will go in shame. Be renewed toward Me, islands.
verses.45:17: Israel is saved by the Lord with an eternal salvation; they will not be put to shame, nor will they at all be humiliated forever."
verses.45:18: Thus says the Lord who made heaven—this is the God who displayed the earth and made it; He Himself marked it out; He did not make it in vain, but formed it to be inhabited: "I am, and there is no other.
verses.45:19: I have not spoken in secret, nor in a dark place of the earth; I did not say to the seed of Jacob, 'Seek what is vain'; I am, I am the Lord, who speaks righteousness and declares truth.
verses.45:20: Gather together and come; take counsel together, you who are being saved from the nations. They do not know—those who carry the wood, their carved image, and who pray to gods that do not save.
verses.45:21: If they will declare it, let them draw near, so that they may know together who made these things heard from the beginning; then it was declared to you: 'I am God, and there is no other besides Me, righteous and a Savior; there is none apart from Me.'
verses.45:22: Turn to Me and you will be saved, you from the end of the earth; I am God, and there is no other.
verses.45:23: By Myself I swear that righteousness will surely go out from My mouth; My words will not be turned back, for to Me every knee will bow, and every tongue will swear by God,
verses.45:24: saying, 'Righteousness and glory will come to Him,' and all who separate themselves will be put to shame;
verses.45:25: by the Lord they will be justified, and in God all the seed of the sons of Israel will be glorified."
verses.46:1: Bel has fallen; Nebo has been shattered; their carved images have come to be for wild beasts and the livestock; carry them bound up as a load for one who is weary,
verses.46:2: faint and hungry, altogether lacking strength; who will not be able to be saved from war, but they themselves were led away captive.
verses.46:3: Listen to Me, house of Jacob and all the remnant of Israel, who are carried from the womb and instructed from childhood:
verses.46:4: even to old age I am, and until you grow old, I am; I bear with you; I made, and I will forgive; I will take up and save you.
verses.46:5: To whom have you likened Me? See, contrive, you who go astray,
verses.46:6: those who contribute gold from a pouch and silver on a balance; they will weigh it on a scale, and having hired a goldsmith, they made things made with hands, and stooping down, they worship them.
verses.46:7: They lift it onto the shoulder and walk along; and if they set it down, it remains in its place; it will certainly not move; and whoever cries out to it, it will certainly not listen; from evils it will certainly not save him.
verses.46:8: Remember these things and groan; repent, you who have gone astray, return in heart,
verses.46:9: and remember the former things from of old, for I am God, and there is no other besides Me,
verses.46:10: declaring beforehand the last things before they happen, and at once it was accomplished; and I said, "All My counsel will stand, and all that I have purposed I will do";
verses.46:11: calling a bird from the east, and from a land far away concerning the things I have purposed; I spoke and brought it, I created and made it, I brought him and prospered his way.
verses.46:12: Listen to Me, you who have lost heart, you who are far from righteousness.
verses.46:13: I have brought My righteousness near, and the salvation from Me I will not delay; I have given salvation in Zion to Israel for glory.
verses.47:1: Come down, sit on the ground, virgin daughter of Babylon; sit on the ground, daughter of the Chaldeans, for you will no longer continue to be called tender and delicate.
verses.47:2: Take a millstone, grind flour; uncover your veil, uncover your gray hairs, bare your legs, cross over rivers;
verses.47:3: your shame will be uncovered, your reproaches will appear; I will take justice from you; no longer will I yield to human beings.
verses.47:4: The One who rescues you is the Lord Sabaoth; His name is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.47:5: Sit stunned, enter into the darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans; no longer will you be called the strength of a kingdom.
verses.47:6: I was provoked against My people; you defiled My inheritance; I gave them into your hand, yet you gave them no mercy; you made the yoke of the aged exceedingly heavy,
verses.47:7: and you said, "Forever I will be a ruler." You did not consider these things in your heart, nor did you remember the last things.
verses.47:8: Now then, hear these things, you delicate one, who sits, who is confident, who says in her heart, "I am, and there is no other; I will not sit as a widow, nor will I know bereavement."
verses.47:9: But now it will come suddenly upon you in your sorcery, in the strength of your enchantments, exceedingly,
verses.47:10: in the hope of your wickedness. For you said, "I am, and there is no other." Know: the understanding of these things and your prostitution will be a shame to you; and you said in your heart, "I am, and there is no other."
verses.47:11: And destruction will come upon you, and you will certainly not know it; a pit, and you will fall into it; and misery will come upon you, and you will certainly not be able to become clean; and destruction will come upon you suddenly, and you will not know.
verses.47:12: Stand now in your enchantments and your abundant sorcery, which you were learning from your youth, if you will be able to be helped.
verses.47:13: You have labored in your counsels; let the astrologers of heaven stand and save you; let those who watch the stars declare to you what is about to come upon you.
verses.47:14: Look, all of them will be burned up like brushwood on a fire, and they will certainly not rescue their life from the flame; for you have coals of fire—sit upon them!
verses.47:15: These will be a help to you; you have labored in trade from youth; each person went astray on his own; but for you there will be no salvation.
verses.48:1: Hear these things, house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel and who came out from Judah, who swear by the name of the Lord, God of Israel, remembering not with truth nor with righteousness,
verses.48:2: and clinging to the name of the holy city, and relying on the God of Israel—the Lord Sabaoth is His name.
verses.48:3: The former things I already declared, and from My mouth it went out and was heard; suddenly I acted, and it came about.
verses.48:4: I know that you are hard, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your forehead is bronze.
verses.48:5: And I declared things of old to you before they came upon you; I made it heard to you, so that you would never say, "The idols did it for me," and say, "The carved images and the cast images commanded me."
verses.48:6: You heard everything, and you did not know; but I made the new things heard to you from now on that are about to happen, and you did not say,
verses.48:7: "Now it is happening, and not long ago," and in former days you did not hear them; do not say, "Yes, I know them."
verses.48:8: Neither did you know, nor did you understand, nor from the beginning did I open your ears; for I knew that you would certainly break faith, and you will be called lawless even from the womb.
verses.48:9: For the sake of My name I will show you My wrath, and I will bring My glorious deeds upon you, so that I may not utterly destroy you.
verses.48:10: Look, I have sold you, not for silver; yet I rescued you from the furnace of poverty;
verses.48:11: for My own sake I will act for you, because My name is being profaned, and My glory I will not give to another.
verses.48:12: Hear Me, Jacob, and Israel whom I call: I am the first, and I am forever,
verses.48:13: and My hand laid the foundation of the earth, and My right hand made heaven firm; I will call them, and they will stand together,
verses.48:14: and all of them will be gathered together and will hear. Who declared these things to them? Loving you, I carried out your will against Babylon, to remove the seed of the Chaldeans;
verses.48:15: I spoke, I called, I brought him and made his way prosperous.
verses.48:16: Draw near to Me and hear these things; from the beginning I have not spoken in secret; when it came to be, I was there, and now the Lord, the Lord, has sent Me and His Spirit.
verses.48:17: Thus says the Lord, the Deliverer, the Holy One of Israel: "I am your God; I have shown you how to find the way in which you will walk.
verses.48:18: And if you had listened to My commandments, your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness like a wave of the sea;
verses.48:19: and your seed would have been like the sand, and the offspring of your womb like the dust of the earth; nor even now will you ever be utterly destroyed, nor will your name perish before Me."
verses.48:20: Go out from Babylon, fleeing from the Chaldeans; declare a voice of gladness, and let this be heard; declare it to the end of the earth; say, "The Lord has rescued His servant Jacob!"
verses.48:21: And if they thirst, through a desert He will lead water for them; from a rock He will bring it out for them; a rock will be split and water will flow, and My people will drink.
verses.48:22: "There is no rejoicing," says the Lord, "for the ungodly."
verses.49:1: Listen to me, islands, and pay attention, nations: "After a long time it will stand," says the Lord. From my mother's womb He called my name,
verses.49:2: and He made my mouth like a sharp sword, and under the shelter of His hand He hid me; He made me like a chosen arrow, and in His quiver He hid me,
verses.49:3: and He said to me, "You are My servant, Israel, and in you I will be glorified."
verses.49:4: And I said, "In vain I have labored; for emptiness and for nothing I have given my strength; therefore my justice is with the Lord, and my toil is before my God."
verses.49:5: And now, thus says the Lord, who formed me from the womb as a servant for Himself, to gather Jacob to Him and Israel—I will be gathered and glorified before the Lord, and God will be my strength—
verses.49:6: and He said to me, "It is a great thing for you to be called My servant, to raise up the tribes of Jacob and to bring back the dispersion of Israel; look, I have given you as a covenant for a people, as a light for nations, so that you may be for salvation to the end of the earth."
verses.49:7: Thus says the Lord, who rescues you, the God of Israel: "Sanctify the one who despises his own soul, the one who is abhorred by the nations, the servants of the rulers; kings will see him, and rulers will stand up and bow down to him for the sake of the Lord; because the Holy One of Israel is faithful, and I have chosen you."
verses.49:8: Thus says the Lord: "In an acceptable time I listened to you, and on a day of salvation I helped you; and I formed you and gave you as a covenant for nations, to establish the land and to inherit desolate inheritances,
verses.49:9: saying to those in bonds, 'Come out,' and to those in the darkness to be revealed. Along all the roads they will graze, and on all paths will be their pasture;
verses.49:10: they will not hunger, nor will they thirst, nor will scorching heat strike them, nor the sun, but the One who has mercy on them will comfort them, and through springs of waters He will lead them;
verses.49:11: and I will make every mountain into a road, and every path into pasture for them.
verses.49:12: Look, these will come from afar; these from the north and the sea, and others from the land of the Persians."
verses.49:13: Be glad, heavens, and let the earth rejoice; let the mountains break forth with gladness, because God has had mercy on His people, and He has comforted the humble of His people.
verses.49:14: But Zion said, "The Lord has forsaken me, and the Lord has forgotten me."
verses.49:15: "Can a woman forget her little child, or not have mercy on the offspring of her womb? Yet even if a woman should forget these, I will not forget you," said the Lord.
verses.49:16: Look, on My hands I have painted your walls, and you are before Me continually;
verses.49:17: and quickly you will be built by those who tore you down, and those who laid you waste will go out from you.
verses.49:18: Lift up your eyes all around and see them all; look, they have gathered together and come to you. "As I live," says the Lord, "surely you will clothe yourself with all of them like an ornament, and you will put them around yourself like an ornament, like a bride."
verses.49:19: For your desolate places and your ruined places and your fallen places will now be cramped because of the inhabitants, and those who swallow you up will be far away from you.
verses.49:20: For your sons whom you have lost will say in your ears, "The place is too cramped for me; make a place for me so that I may dwell."
verses.49:21: And you will say in your heart, "Who bore these for me? Yet I am childless and a widow. And who raised these for me? I was left alone, and where were these for me?"
verses.49:22: Thus says the Lord: "Look, I am lifting up My hand to the nations, and to the islands I will lift up My signal; and they will bring your sons in their bosom, and your daughters they will carry on their shoulders;
verses.49:23: and kings will be your foster fathers, and their princesses your nurses; upon the face of the earth they will bow down to you, and they will lick the dust of your feet; and you will know that I am the Lord, and those who wait for Me will not be put to shame."
verses.49:24: Will anyone take plunder from a giant? And if anyone takes captives unjustly, will he be saved?
verses.49:25: Thus says the Lord: "If anyone takes a giant captive, he will take plunder; and one taking from a strong man will be saved; and I will judge your case, and I will rescue your sons;
verses.49:26: and those who afflicted you will eat their own flesh, and they will drink their own blood like new wine and become drunk; and all flesh will perceive that I am the Lord, who rescues you and upholds the strength of Jacob."
verses.50:1: Thus says the Lord: "What is the certificate of your mother's divorce, with which I sent her away? Or to what debtor did I sell you? Look, because of your sins you were sold, and because of your lawless deeds I sent your mother away.
verses.50:2: Why is it that I came, and there was no one? I called, and there was no one who heeded? Is My hand not strong enough to deliver? Or am I not strong enough to rescue? Look, by My rebuke I will lay waste the sea, and I will make rivers desolate, and their fish will dry up because there is no water, and they will die in thirst.
verses.50:3: I will clothe heaven with darkness, and I will make its covering like sackcloth."
verses.50:4: The Lord gives me a tongue of instruction to know when one ought to speak a word; He set it for me in the morning, He added to me an ear to hear,
verses.50:5: and the instruction of the Lord, the Lord, opens my ears, and I do not disobey, nor do I speak against it.
verses.50:6: I gave my back to scourges, and my cheeks to slaps, and my face I did not turn away from the shame of spitting,
verses.50:7: and the Lord, the Lord, became my helper; therefore I was not disgraced, but I set my face like a solid rock, and I knew that I will never be put to shame.
verses.50:8: For the One who justified me draws near; who is the one contending with me? Let him stand against me at the same time; and who is the one contending with me? Let him draw near to me.
verses.50:9: Look, the Lord will help me; who will harm me? Look, all of you will wear out like a garment, and a moth will devour you.
verses.50:10: Who among you is the one who fears the Lord? Let him heed the voice of His servant; those who walk in darkness, and there is no light for them—trust in the name of the Lord and rely on God.
verses.50:11: Look, all of you light a fire and strengthen a flame; walk by the light of your fire and by the flame that you have kindled. Because of Me these things happened to you; in sorrow you will lie down.
verses.51:1: Listen to Me, you who pursue what is right and seek the Lord: look at the solid rock that you quarried, and at the hole of the pit that you dug.
verses.51:2: Look at Abraham your father, and at Sarah who was in labor with you; for he was one, and I called him, and I blessed him and loved him.
verses.51:3: And now I will comfort you, Zion, and I have comforted all her desolate places, and I will make her desolate places like a paradise, and the regions toward the west like the paradise of the Lord; gladness and exultation they will find in her, thanksgiving and a voice of praise.
verses.51:4: Listen to Me, listen to Me, My people, and you kings, give ear to Me; for a law will go out from Me, and My justice for a light of nations.
